title: Alignment by Confident Debate: Preference Learning from Multi-Agent Debate
title_zh: 基于自信辩论的对齐：从多智能体辩论中进行偏好学习

paragraphs.en: Post-training language models for reasoning typically rely on gold answers, task-specific verifiers, or learned reward models, limiting scalability when such signals are scarce. Multi-agent debate offers a self-supervised alternative, but converting debate into reliable training supervision remains challenging: majority voting weights agreeing responses equally, lacks a principled tie-breaking rule, and is ill-defined for open-ended tasks without a canonical answer; likelihood-based scoring can conflate fluency with correctness; and homogeneous committees may reinforce correlated errors. We introduce Alignment by Confident Debate (AbCD), which converts debate traces into preference data without gold answer labels. A sampling-diverse committee debates each problem, after which final answers are clustered by task-level semantic equivalence. Each cluster is scored by aggregating confidence on its claimed answer, and completions from the highest-scoring cluster are labeled as preferred over the remaining completions. We use verifiable tasks (mathematical reasoning, multiple-choice quantitative QA, and executable code-generation) as a controlled test bed: their answer keys or executable checkers let us evaluate the quality of debate-derived supervision against ground truth, even though the oracle itself never uses gold labels. Post-training on the resulting preferences outperforms inference-only ensembling and debate, as well as SFT on the same traces, across five model families spanning 1B to 8B parameters and four datasets, improving consensus accuracy, with a maximum gain of 21.5 p ​ p 21.5_{pp} . Ablations show that the approach transfers to a larger model and to code generation, while also revealing limitations of heterogeneous committees and agreement-based weighting. On tasks with a discrete answer, majority voting is the standard ensemble and lands close to confidence ensembling, because both aggregate the same extracted strings; that comparison is reported in the appendix. Overall, the results suggest that debate traces can yield useful preference supervision when answer equivalence is combined with confidence-weighted disagreement.
paragraphs.zh: 用于推理的后训练语言模型通常依赖标准答案、任务专用验证器或学习到的奖励模型，当这些信号稀缺时会限制可扩展性。 多智能体辩论提供了一种自监督的替代方案，但将辩论转化为可靠的训练监督仍然具有挑战性：多数投票对一致的回答赋予相同权重，缺乏有原则的平局裁决规则，并且对于没有标准答案的开放式任务定义不清；基于似然的评分可能将流畅性与正确性混为一谈；同质化的委员会可能会强化相关联的错误。 我们提出通过自信辩论进行对齐（Alignment by Confident Debate, AbCD），它无需标准答案标签即可将辩论轨迹转化为偏好数据。 由采样多样化的委员会对每个问题进行辩论，随后按任务层面的语义等价性对最终答案进行聚类。 每个聚类通过聚合其所声称答案上的置信度进行评分，来自得分最高聚类的完成结果被标记为优于其余完成结果。 我们使用可验证任务（数学推理、多选题定量问答和可执行的代码生成）作为受控测试平台：它们的答案密钥或可执行检查器使我们能够对照真实标准评估辩论所得监督的质量，尽管该裁判本身从不使用标准答案标签。 在由此得到的偏好上进行后训练，优于仅推理的集成和辩论，也优于在相同轨迹上的SFT，实验覆盖参数量从1B到8B的五个模型系列和四个数据集，提升了共识准确率，最大增益为21.5 p ​ p 21.5_{pp} 。 消融实验表明该方法可以迁移到更大的模型和代码生成任务，同时也揭示了异质化委员会和基于一致性的加权的局限性。 在具有离散答案的任务上，多数投票是标准的集成方法，其结果接近置信度集成，因为两者聚合的是相同的抽取字符串；该比较结果在附录中报告。 总体而言，结果表明当答案等价性与置信度加权的分歧相结合时，辩论轨迹可以产生有用的偏好监督。

paragraphs.en: Post-training for reasoning typically relies on external supervision to identify desirable solutions or solution traces. Such supervision can come from labeled demonstrations or gold answers, task-specific verifiers that evaluate final outcomes, or learned evaluators such as reward models and LLM-based judges. Gold answers and executable verifiers provide direct correctness signals when an answer key or reliable checking procedure exists, as in numerical reasoning and unit-tested code ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Yuan et al., 2023 ; Austin et al., 2021 ) . Reward models and LLM-based judges extend evaluation to less readily verifiable outputs ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . However, these evaluators must themselves be trained, calibrated, or otherwise trusted and may share systematic errors with the policy being optimized. Thus, although post-training objectives are well established, obtaining reliable correctness supervision remains difficult and domain-dependent.
paragraphs.zh: 推理的后训练通常依赖外部监督来识别可取的解答或解答轨迹。 此类监督可以来自带标注的演示或标准答案、评估最终结果的任务特定验证器，或学习型评估器（如奖励模型和基于大语言模型的裁判）。 当存在答案密钥或可靠的检查流程时（如数值推理和经单元测试的代码），标准答案和可执行验证器能提供直接的正确性信号 ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Yuan et al., 2023 ; Austin et al., 2021 ) 。 奖励模型和基于大语言模型的裁判将评估扩展到较难验证的输出 ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) 。 然而，这些评估器本身必须经过训练、校准或以其他方式获得信任，并且可能与被优化的策略共享系统性错误。 因此，尽管后训练目标已相当成熟，获得可靠的正确性监督仍然困难且依赖于具体领域。

paragraphs.en: When external correctness supervision is unavailable, agreement among the model’s own samples provides a natural candidate signal. Multi-agent debate allows several agents to exchange reasoning over multiple rounds, and can improve answer accuracy relative to a single sampled solution ( Du et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) . Subsequent debate-training methods often use these traces for training, for example by labeling the majority answer as preferred and the remaining answers as dispreferred ( Samanta et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) . This strategy is fragile, however. In homogeneous committees, communication need not improve correctness beyond independent sampling ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) ; repeated interaction can also induce correlated reasoning and convergence on shared errors ( Dai, 2026 ) . On GSM8K, for example, a five-agent committee achieves its largest consensus accuracy after the first exchange, whereas additional rounds increase agreement without improving—and in some cases reducing—correctness (Figure 1 ). Consensus is therefore an outcome of the interaction and selection process, not by itself evidence that the selected answer is correct. We therefore study how to convert debate traces into preference supervision by separating answer equivalence from answer selection: final answers are clustered by task-level semantic equivalence and the resulting clusters are ranked by aggregate confidence in their claimed answer spans.
paragraphs.zh: 当外部正确性监督不可用时，模型自身样本之间的一致性提供了一种天然的候选信号。 多智能体辩论允许多个智能体在多轮中交换推理，相对于单个采样解可以提升答案准确率（Du et al., 2023; Liang et al., 2024; Madaan et al., 2023）。 后续的辩论训练方法通常利用这些轨迹进行训练，例如将多数答案标注为偏好答案，其余答案标注为非偏好答案（Samanta et al., 2025; Zhou et al., 2025）。 然而，这一策略是脆弱的。 在同质化委员会中，交流未必能超越独立采样而提升正确性（Zhu et al., 2026）；重复交互还可能引发相关性推理并收敛到共同的错误上（Dai, 2026）。 例如在 GSM8K 上，五智能体委员会在第一次交换后达到最高的共识准确率，而额外的轮次会增加一致性却不提升正确性——某些情况下甚至降低正确性（图 1）。 因此，共识只是交互与选择过程的结果，其本身并不能作为被选答案正确的证据。 因此，我们研究如何将辩论轨迹转化为偏好监督，方法是将答案等价性与答案选择分离开来：先按任务级语义等价性对最终答案进行聚类，再根据各聚类所声称答案片段的聚合置信度对这些聚类进行排序。

paragraphs.en: Majority voting requires a procedure for mapping final answers to equivalent outcomes. Without a canonical answer or reliable semantic-equivalence rule, voting cannot determine when two responses should count as equivalent, particularly for open-ended generation where correct responses may differ in wording ( Chen et al., 2023 ) . Even when equivalence is available, majority voting treats all agreeing traces equally and provides no additional signal for resolving ties. In small committees of cloned models, agreement may also reflect correlated errors rather than independent corroboration. Token probabilities provide another signal available during generation, but they measure the likelihood of generated tokens rather than correctness of the full reasoning chain. Length-normalized full-trace likelihood can therefore favor fluent or familiar reasoning without reliably identifying the correct answer. Confidence computed on answer-relevant tokens is a more targeted alternative and has been used to improve answer selection ( Razghandi et al., 2025 ; Lin and Hooi, 2025 ) . Nevertheless, these scores remain imperfect proxies because language models can be overconfident, and identifying the answer-relevant span may itself depend on the task. Exisiting confidence-based approaches largely use such scores for inference-time selection; we instead use them to construct preference data from debate traces.
paragraphs.zh: 多数投票需要一个将最终答案映射到等价结果的程序。 在缺乏规范答案或可靠的语义等价规则的情况下，投票无法判定两个回答何时应被视为等价，尤其是在开放式生成任务中，正确的回答可能在措辞上有所不同（Chen et al., 2023）。 即使可以判定等价性，多数投票也会平等对待所有达成一致的推理轨迹，并且在平票时无法提供额外的信号来加以解决。 在由克隆模型组成的小型委员会中，一致性也可能反映的是相关联的错误，而非独立的相互印证。 词元概率提供了另一种在生成过程中可获得的信号，但它衡量的是生成词元的可能性，而非完整推理链的正确性。 因此，经过长度归一化的完整轨迹似然可能会偏向流畅或常见的推理，而无法可靠地识别正确答案。 在与答案相关的词元上计算的置信度是一种更有针对性的替代方案，并已被用于改进答案选择（Razghandi et al., 2025; Lin and Hooi, 2025）。 然而，这些分数仍然是不完美的代理指标，因为语言模型可能过度自信，而且识别与答案相关的片段本身也可能依赖于具体任务。 现有的基于置信度的方法主要在推理时使用这些分数进行选择；我们则利用它们从辩论轨迹中构建偏好数据。

paragraphs.en: That gap motivates Alignment by Confident Debate (AbCD), which constructs preference data from debate traces without using gold answer labels for supervision. A sampling-diverse committee generates and exchanges solutions over multiple debate rounds, after which final answers are clustered by task-level semantic equivalence. We score each cluster by aggregate confidence on its claimed answer-span rather than by the likelihood of the full reasoning trace. Completions from the highest-scoring cluster are labeled preferred, while completions from the remaining clusters are labeled dispreferred. Agreement rate is recorded as a reliability signal and can optionally be incorporated as a soft weight, but it does not define the winning cluster. On GSM8K, SVAMP, and MathQA, confidence-based cluster selection identifies the correct answer cluster more often than majority voting, particularly on instances with tied vote counts. Post-training on the resulting preferences improves both selected-answer and mean agent accuracy, outperforming inference-only ensembling, inference-only debate, and SFT trained on the same debate traces across the evaluated settings. The same comparison holds for a larger model, for heterogeneous committees, and for execution-based evaluation on code generation. Where an answer is a discrete string, majority voting is the usual ensemble and should track confidence ensembling, so we report the comparison in the appendix N . Outside verifiable tasks a vote is no longer defined in the same way, and AbCD still is, selecting the preferred cluster by confidence in the claimed answer. Ablations on coding and open-ended tasks are reported in Appendix T and U .
paragraphs.zh: 这一差距催生了「置信辩论对齐」（AbCD），该方法从辩论轨迹中构建偏好数据，而无需使用黄金答案标签进行监督。 一个采样多样化的委员会在多轮辩论中生成并交换解法，之后最终答案按任务级语义等价性进行聚类。 我们按各聚类在其所声称的答案片段上的聚合置信度进行打分，而不是按完整推理轨迹的似然打分。 得分最高聚类的补全被标注为偏好补全，其余聚类的补全则被标注为非偏好补全。 一致率被记录为可靠性信号，并可选择作为软权重纳入，但它并不决定胜出聚类。 在 GSM8K、SVAMP 和 MathQA 上，基于置信度的聚类选择比多数投票更常识别出正确答案聚类，尤其是在票数持平的实例上。 在所得偏好上进行后训练可同时提升选定答案准确率与平均智能体准确率，在所评估的各设置中均优于仅推理的集成、仅推理的辩论，以及在相同辩论轨迹上训练的 SFT。 对于更大的模型、异构委员会，以及代码生成中基于执行的评估，同样的比较结果依然成立。 当答案是离散字符串时，多数投票是常用的集成方法，且应与置信度集成结果相近，因此我们在附录 N 中报告该比较。 在可验证任务之外，投票不再以同样的方式定义，而 AbCD 依然适用，它按所声称答案的置信度选择偏好聚类。 关于编程任务与开放式任务的消融实验分别在附录 T 和附录 U 中报告。

sents.en: That gap motivates Alignment by Confident Debate (AbCD), which constructs preference data from debate traces without using gold answer labels for supervision.
sents.zh: 这一差距催生了「置信辩论对齐」（AbCD），该方法从辩论轨迹中构建偏好数据，而无需使用黄金答案标签进行监督。

sents.en: A sampling-diverse committee generates and exchanges solutions over multiple debate rounds, after which final answers are clustered by task-level semantic equivalence.
sents.zh: 一个采样多样化的委员会在多轮辩论中生成并交换解法，之后最终答案按任务级语义等价性进行聚类。

sents.en: We score each cluster by aggregate confidence on its claimed answer-span rather than by the likelihood of the full reasoning trace.
sents.zh: 我们按各聚类在其所声称的答案片段上的聚合置信度进行打分，而不是按完整推理轨迹的似然打分。

sents.en: Completions from the highest-scoring cluster are labeled preferred, while completions from the remaining clusters are labeled dispreferred.
sents.zh: 得分最高聚类的补全被标注为偏好补全，其余聚类的补全则被标注为非偏好补全。

sents.en: Agreement rate is recorded as a reliability signal and can optionally be incorporated as a soft weight, but it does not define the winning cluster.
sents.zh: 一致率被记录为可靠性信号，并可选择作为软权重纳入，但它并不决定胜出聚类。

sents.en: On GSM8K, SVAMP, and MathQA, confidence-based cluster selection identifies the correct answer cluster more often than majority voting, particularly on instances with tied vote counts.
sents.zh: 在 GSM8K、SVAMP 和 MathQA 上，基于置信度的聚类选择比多数投票更常识别出正确答案聚类，尤其是在票数持平的实例上。

sents.en: Post-training on the resulting preferences improves both selected-answer and mean agent accuracy, outperforming inference-only ensembling, inference-only debate, and SFT trained on the same debate traces across the evaluated settings.

sents.en: We make the following contributions:
sents.zh: 我们做出以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We propose a confidence-based debate oracle that separates task-level answer equivalence from answer selection: equivalence groups completions into answer clusters, while confidence mass on the claimed-answer span determines the cluster weight.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种基于置信度的辩论裁决器（debate oracle），它将任务级答案等价性与答案选择分离开来：等价性将候选回答划分为答案簇，而所声明答案片段上的置信度质量则决定各簇的权重。

paragraphs.en: We construct a gold-label-free preference-data pipeline that converts the oracle’s cluster assignments into preferred and dispreferred completions for standard post-training objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个无需黄金标签的偏好数据流水线，将智能体的聚类分配转换为标准后训练目标所需的偏好与不偏好补全结果。

paragraphs.en: We characterize the effects of committee diversity and debate depth through controlled experiments. Empirical observations suggest that sampling-diverse committees capture most of the observed benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过受控实验刻画了委员会多样性与辩论深度的影响。 实证观察表明，采样多样的智能体委员会能够获得大部分已观察到的收益。

sents.en: We characterize the effects of committee diversity and debate depth through controlled experiments.
sents.zh: 我们通过受控实验刻画了委员会多样性与辩论深度的影响。

sents.en: Empirical observations suggest that sampling-diverse committees capture most of the observed benefit.
sents.zh: 实证观察表明，采样多样的智能体委员会能够获得大部分已观察到的收益。

paragraphs.en: Self-consistency aggregates independently sampled solutions by majority vote when final answers can be mapped to equivalent outcomes ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , and universal self-consistency extends this idea to free-form outputs by using an LLM to select a consistent answer among candidates ( Chen et al., 2023 ) . Multi-agent debate instead allows agents to exchange reasoning over multiple rounds and can improve answer selection relative to a single sampled solution ( Du et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) . However, these gains are not guaranteed: under homogeneous agents, debate preserves expected correctness over time and can underperform independent voting ( Choi et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) , and repeated interaction can increase similarity among agents’ rationales, amplifying shared errors ( Dai, 2026 ) . These findings motivate treating consensus as an outcome of the interaction and selection process rather than as a correctness label.
paragraphs.zh: 自洽性方法在最终答案能够映射到等价结果时，通过对独立采样的解进行多数投票来聚合结果（Wang et al., 2022），而通用自洽性方法将这一思想扩展到自由格式输出，利用大语言模型从候选答案中选择一个一致的答案（Chen et al., 2023）。 多智能体辩论则允许智能体在多轮交互中交换推理过程，相对于单个采样解，能够改进答案的选择（Du et al., 2023; Liang et al., 2024; Madaan et al., 2023）。 然而，这些收益并非必然：在同质智能体的情况下，辩论会随时间保持期望正确率不变，并可能不如独立投票（Choi et al., 2026; Zhu et al., 2026），而且重复交互会增加智能体之间推理依据的相似性，从而放大共同错误（Dai, 2026）。 这些发现促使我们将共识视为交互与选择过程的结果，而非正确性的标志。

paragraphs.en: Token likelihoods provide an alternative to vote counts, but full-response likelihood is a coarse signal because it scores all generated tokens, including reasoning tokens that may be only weakly tied to final-answer correctness. Confidence computed on answer-relevant tokens provides a more targeted correctness signal ( Razghandi et al., 2025 ; Lin and Hooi, 2025 ) , and related work uses confidence estimates (including verbalized confidence, token-distribution statistics, and calibrated answer-token scores) to select answers at inference time ( Taubenfeld et al., 2025 ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Tian et al., 2023 ) . Our work differs in using claimed answer-span confidence to construct preferred and dispreferred traces for post-training. An extended discussion of related work, including a finer-grained taxonomy of debate-based and confidence-based methods, is provided in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: Token 似然提供了对票数统计的一种替代方案，但完整响应的似然是一个较为粗糙的信号，因为它对所有生成的 token 打分，包括那些与最终答案正确性仅有微弱关联的推理 token。 基于与答案相关的 token 计算出的置信度提供了更具针对性的正确性信号（Razghandi et al., 2025；Lin and Hooi, 2025），相关工作还利用置信度估计（包括口头表达的置信度、token 分布统计以及经过校准的答案 token 分数）在推理阶段选择答案（Taubenfeld et al., 2025；Kang et al., 2026；Kadavath et al., 2022；Tian et al., 2023）。 我们的工作的不同之处在于，使用所声称答案片段的置信度来构建用于后训练的偏好与不偏好轨迹。 相关工作的扩展讨论，包括对基于辩论和基于置信度的方法更细粒度的分类，见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: Prior methods construct training signals from verifier-approved traces ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Gulcehre et al., 2023 ) , pseudo-labels derived from sampled answers ( Zuo et al., 2026 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) , or judgments from another language model ( Yuan et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2022 ) . Other work uses debate traces for imitation, preference learning, or multi-agent reinforcement learning ( Subramaniam et al., 2025 ; Srivastava et al., 2025 ; Samanta et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Motwani et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . These methods differ in how they identify preferred traces and assign training weights. To our knowledge, prior debate-training methods do not construct preference pairs by ranking task-level answer-equivalence clusters using aggregate claimed answer-span confidence. AbCD combines answer-equivalence with span-confidence mass, while treating agreement as a reliability statistic rather than as the definition of the winning answer.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的方法从验证器批准的推理轨迹（Zelikman et al., 2022；Gulcehre et al., 2023）、从采样答案导出的伪标签（Zuo et al., 2026；Shao et al., 2024）或来自另一个语言模型的判断（Yuan et al., 2024；Bai et al., 2022）来构建训练信号。 其他工作使用辩论轨迹进行模仿学习、偏好学习或多智能体强化学习（Subramaniam et al., 2025；Srivastava et al., 2025；Samanta et al., 2025；Zhou et al., 2025；Motwani et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2026）。 这些方法在如何识别偏好轨迹以及如何分配训练权重方面各不相同。 据我们所知，先前的辩论训练方法并未通过使用汇总的所声称答案跨度置信度对任务级答案等价聚类进行排序来构建偏好对。 AbCD 将答案等价性与跨度置信度质量相结合，同时将一致性视为一种可靠性统计量，而非对获胜答案的定义。

We instantiate N N sampling-diverse agents from π θ \pi_{\theta} per query and run M M rounds of multi-agent debate. The final traces are clustered according to task-level answer equivalence. paragraphs.en: We evaluate AbCD in three stages: committee configuration, oracle selection, and post-training. We first fix the committee and debate configuration through inference-only experiments, then compare full-trace and answer-span confidence on identical transcripts, and finally lock the winning configuration for all post-training experiments. This separates decisions about generating debate traces from decisions about labeling and using those traces for training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分三个阶段评估 AbCD：委员会配置、oracle 选择和后训练。 我们首先通过仅推理实验确定委员会和辩论配置，然后在相同的对话记录上比较全轨迹置信度与答案片段置信度，最后锁定获胜配置用于所有后训练实验。 这将关于生成辩论轨迹的决策与关于标注这些轨迹并将其用于训练的决策分离开来。

We post-train five instruction-tuned models: Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it, Llama-3.2-1B-it, Phi-4-mini-3.8B-it, Gemma-3-4B-it, and Llama-3.1-8B-it ( Qwen et al., 2025 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Abouelenin et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 ) . Unless otherwise noted, post-training uses a single iteration from the instruction-tuned checkpoint with QLoRA (4-bit base model, rank r = 32 r{=}32 ). Datasets. We evaluate mathematical reasoning on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) and SVAMP ( Patel et al., 2021 ) , quantitative question answering on MathQA ( Amini et al., 2019 ) , and code generation on MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 ) . GSM8K and SVAMP use boxed numerical answers, MathQA uses answer-choice letters, and MBPP uses executable Python programs; the corresponding dataset and task-equivalence details are provided in Appendix C . Gold answers are used only for evaluation and designated ablations, never for debate, oracle construction, or post-training. Debate protocol. Each prompt is answered by a sampling-diverse committee of N = 5 N{=}5 agents for M = 2 M{=}2 rounds: independent generation followed by one exchange round. The agents use temperatures { 0.01 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1.0 } \{0.01,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0\} . Unless otherwise noted, decoding uses top- p = 0.9 p{=}0.9 and at most 256 256 new tokens. Detailed inference and training configurations are given in Appendix G . Metrics. We report pre-debate agent accuracy , the mean accuracy of the independently sampled responses; post-debate agent accuracy , the mean accuracy of the N N responses after the final round; and consensus accuracy , the accuracy of the answer cluster selected by the confidence-based oracle. Accuracies are computed against gold labels on the full test set, with missing or unparseable outputs counted as incorrect.

paragraphs.en: We first characterize committee behavior using inference-only experiments to determine the default configuration for debating. Varying committee size from N = 1 N{=}1 to N = 9 N{=}9 with independent sampling at temperature 0.5 0.5 shows that consensus accuracy improves up to N = 5 N{=}5 , with diminishing returns thereafter (Figure 3(a) ). The first exchange round provides an additional gain, while further rounds increase agreement (Figure 3(c) ) without improving consensus accuracy and can reduce correctness (Figure 3(d) ). We observe the same trend across models and datasets; additional results are provided in Appendix E . This divergence shows that agreement alone is not a reliable proxy for correctness, motivating an oracle that uses more than vote count. We therefore lock N = 5 N{=}5 and M = 2 M{=}2 as the default. Among the diversity strategies evaluated, temperature diversity outperforms homogeneous clones, role diversity, and seed diversity (Appendix Table 8 ); we therefore use temperature-diverse committees by default.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先通过仅推理实验刻画委员会行为，以确定辩论的默认配置。 将委员会规模从 N = 1 N{=}1 变到 N = 9 N{=}9 并在温度 0.5 0.5 下进行独立采样，结果显示共识准确率在 N = 5 N{=}5 之前持续提升，此后收益递减（图 3(a)）。 第一轮交换带来额外增益，而更多轮次会增加一致性（图 3(c)），但不提升共识准确率，甚至可能降低正确性（图 3(d)）。 我们在不同模型和数据集上观察到相同趋势；更多结果见附录 E。 这种分歧表明，一致性本身并不能可靠地代表正确性，因此需要一个使用投票数以外信息的 oracle。 因此我们将 N = 5 N{=}5 和 M = 2 M{=}2 锁定为默认设置。 在评估的多样性策略中，温度多样性优于同质克隆、角色多样性和种子多样性（附录表 8）；因此我们默认使用温度多样的委员会。

paragraphs.en: Before constructing the preference dataset, we determine which portion of each response should be used to compute confidence. For agent i i , we compare full-trace confidence c i trace c_{i}^{\mathrm{trace}} with claimed answer-span confidence c i span c_{i}^{\mathrm{span}} , computed from the same debate transcripts to isolate the effect of the scored tokens. Figure 4 and Table 9 report AUROC for distinguishing correct from incorrect final answers before and after the first exchange. Across 12 model–dataset pairs, full-trace AUROC decreases by an average of 0.07 0.07 after the first exchange, whereas answer-span AUROC increases by an average of 0.04 0.04 (details in Appendix F ). This pattern is consistent with full-trace likelihood capturing properties of intermediate reasoning tokens whose fluency need not reflect final-answer correctness. Although the trend is not uniform across models, the aggregate comparison motivates using the claimed answer-span; we therefore set c i answer := c i span c_{i}^{\mathrm{answer}}:=c_{i}^{\mathrm{span}} in all subsequent experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 在构建偏好数据集之前，我们首先确定每条回复中的哪一部分应用于计算置信度。 对于智能体 i i ，我们在相同的辩论转录文本上比较全程轨迹置信度 c i trace c_{i}^{\mathrm{trace}} 与所称答案跨度置信度 c i span c_{i}^{\mathrm{span}} ，以隔离被评分词元的影响。 图 4 和表 9 报告了在第一次交换前后区分最终答案正确与否的 AUROC。 在 12 个模型–数据集组合上，第一次交换后全程轨迹 AUROC 平均下降 0.07 0.07 ，而答案跨度 AUROC 平均上升 0.04 0.04 （详见附录 F ）。 这一模式表明，全程轨迹似然所捕捉的是中间推理词元的某些特性，而这些词元的流畅度未必反映最终答案的正确性。 尽管这一趋势在不同模型之间并不一致，但这一总体比较结果支持采用所称答案跨度；因此，在后续所有实验中我们均设定 c i answer := c i span c_{i}^{\mathrm{answer}}:=c_{i}^{\mathrm{span}} 。

paragraphs.en: We use the answer-span oracle to construct preference data for post-training, comparing inference-only independent sampling ( Ensemble ), inference-only multi-round debate ( Debate ), SFT, and three preference-based objectives (DPO, KTO, GRPO). Results are averaged over two training runs with the same seed and reported with the corresponding standard deviation. All post-training methods use the same debate traces and base model; implementation details are in Appendix G . For SFT, the training target is 𝒢 + \mathcal{G}^{+} , the oracle-selected completions, not gold solutions. For preference-based objectives, completions in 𝒢 + \mathcal{G}^{+} are preferred over those in competing clusters.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用答案区间预言机来构建用于后训练的偏好数据，比较了仅推理的独立采样（Ensemble）、仅推理的多轮辩论（Debate）、SFT 以及三种基于偏好的目标（DPO、KTO、GRPO）。 结果在两次使用相同随机种子的训练运行上取平均，并报告相应的标准差。 所有后训练方法都使用相同的辩论轨迹和基础模型；实现细节见附录 G。 对于 SFT，训练目标是 𝒢 + \mathcal{G}^{+}，即由预言机筛选出的补全结果，而非标准答案。 对于基于偏好的目标，𝒢 + \mathcal{G}^{+} 中的补全结果优于竞争簇中的补全结果。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows that across all 12 model–dataset pairs, the best preference-based objective improves over inference-only debate. DPO achieves the best post-training result on 9 pairs, KTO on 2, and GRPO on 1. The largest gain occurs for Llama-3.2-1B-it on SVAMP, where DPO raises consensus accuracy from 19.0 % 19.0\% to 40.5 % 40.5\% ( + 21.5 p ​ p +21.5_{pp} ); Phi-4-mini-3.8B-it on MathQA shows a comparable gain, from 41.6 % 41.6\% to 59.5 % 59.5\% ( + 17.9 p ​ p +17.9_{pp} ). Gains are smallest in near-ceiling settings, such as SVAMP ( 89.7 % → 90.0 % 89.7\%\!\to\!90.0\% ) and GSM8K ( 87.6 % → 88.3 % 87.6\%\!\to\!88.3\% ) for Phi-4-mini-3.8B-it, consistent with limited room for improvement when baseline accuracy is already high.

paragraphs.en: SFT and preference-based objectives use the same oracle-generated traces, but SFT imitates only the oracle-selected completions, whereas DPO, KTO, and GRPO also use completions from competing clusters. SFT improves over inference-only debate in 7 of 12 settings, while at least one preference-based objective improves over debate in all the settings. This gap suggests that incorporating competing-cluster completions provides training signal beyond the oracle-selected completions used by SFT.
paragraphs.zh: SFT 与基于偏好的目标函数使用相同的由预言机生成的轨迹，但 SFT 仅模仿预言机选择的补全，而 DPO、KTO 和 GRPO 还使用来自竞争集群的补全。 SFT 在 12 个场景中的 7 个场景优于仅推理的辩论，而至少一种基于偏好的目标函数在所有场景中都优于辩论。 这一差距表明，引入竞争集群的补全提供了超越 SFT 所使用的预言机选择的补全之外训练信号。

paragraphs.en: We compare four labeling rules on GSM8K with Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it: gold labels, majority voting, full-trace confidence, and claimed answer-span confidence. Table 3 reports DPO accuracy for cloned and temperature-diverse committees (3-seed averages). The span oracle achieves the highest post-training accuracy in both settings ( 72.4 % 72.4\% and 70.4 % 70.4\% ). Majority voting under-performs span-confidence selection for both committee types. For the cloned committee, gold supervision also falls below the span oracle ( 68.6 % 68.6\% vs. 72.4 % 72.4\% ), whereas for the temperature-diverse committee it remains below the span oracle ( 69.0 % 69.0\% vs. 70.4 % 70.4\% ) but above majority voting ( 68.1 % 68.1\% ). Table 4 compares majority voting (MV) and span-confidence selection on identical, pre-training transcripts. Across four models on GSM8K, the two rules disagree on at most 5.8 % 5.8\% of examples, with span confidence achieving slightly higher average oracle accuracy ( 57.5 % 57.5\% vs. 57.2 % 57.2\% ). On disagreement cases, span confidence selects the correct cluster more often than MV ( 31.4 % 31.4\% vs. 7.8 % 7.8\% ), with a similar advantage on count-tie cases ( 29.8 % 29.8\% vs. 18.3 % 18.3\% ). Check Appendix I.3 for details on more datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 GSM8K 上使用 Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it 比较了四种标注规则：金标准标签、多数投票、完整轨迹置信度以及声称的答案片段置信度。 表 3 报告了克隆委员会和温度多样性委员会的 DPO 准确率（3 个随机种子的平均值）。 片段预言机在两种设置下都取得了最高的训练后准确率（72.4% 和 70.4%）。 对于两种委员会类型，多数投票的表现都不如片段置信度选择。 对于克隆委员会，金标准监督也低于片段预言机（68.6% 对 72.4%）；而对于温度多样性委员会，金标准监督虽仍低于片段预言机（69.0% 对 70.4%），但高于多数投票（68.1%）。 表 4 在相同的训练前转录上比较了多数投票（MV）和片段置信度选择。 在 GSM8K 上的四个模型中，两种规则至多在 5.8% 的样本上不一致，且片段置信度取得了略高的平均预言机准确率（57.5% 对 57.2%）。 在不一致的样本上，片段置信度比 MV 更常选中正确的簇（31.4% 对 7.8%），在计数并列的样本上也具有类似的优势（29.8% 对 18.3%）。 更多数据集的详情请参见附录 I.3。

paragraphs.en: The default committee uses sampling-diverse copies of one policy. We test a heterogeneous committee with one model from each of five families: Llama-3.2-1B-it (L1), Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it (Q1), Qwen3-1.7B-it (Q2), Phi-4-mini-3.8B-it (P4), and Gemma-3-4B-it (G4), all at temperature 0.5 0.5 with M = 2 M{=}2 on GSM8K. DPO updates every member on the same span-oracle preference pairs. Table 5 shows that heterogeneous debate reaches 79.2 % 79.2\% consensus, rising to 87.0 % 87.0\% after DPO ( + 7.8 p ​ p +7.8_{pp} ), while mean agent accuracy increases by 31.4 p ​ p 31.4_{pp} . Per-agent accuracy and more post-training approaches with heterogeneous committee are described in Appendix I.4 . The gap between consensus and mean-agent accuracy ( 18.8 p ​ p 18.8_{pp} ) is far larger than in any homogeneous committee, indicating that the shared preference partition does not benefit all members equally. This exposes a calibration limitation: token-probability confidence may not be comparable across architectures, so cross-model calibration remains an assumption of this experiment rather than an established property. With per-model Platt calibration maps fit on gold correctness, heterogeneous debate consensus gives more than 8 8 pp improvement, while member accuracies stay uneven (Appendix P ).
paragraphs.zh: 默认委员会使用单一策略的采样多样性副本。 我们测试了一个异构委员会，其中包含来自五个模型家族的各一个模型：Llama-3.2-1B-it (L1)、Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it (Q1)、Qwen3-1.7B-it (Q2)、Phi-4-mini-3.8B-it (P4) 和 Gemma-3-4B-it (G4)，全部在温度 0.5 0.5 和 M = 2 M{=}2 的设置下在 GSM8K 上进行测试。 DPO 在相同的片段-oracle 偏好对上更新每个成员。 表 5 显示，异构辩论达到 79.2 % 79.2\% 的共识率，DPO 后升至 87.0 % 87.0\%（ + 7.8 p ​ p +7.8_{pp} ），而平均智能体准确率提高了 31.4 p ​ p 31.4_{pp} 。 各智能体的准确率以及使用异构委员会的更多后训练方法在附录 I.4 中描述。 共识率与平均智能体准确率之间的差距（ 18.8 p ​ p 18.8_{pp} ）远大于任何同构委员会，这表明共享的偏好划分并不能使所有成员同等受益。 这暴露了一个校准局限性：token 概率置信度在不同架构之间可能不可比，因此跨模型校准仍是本实验的一个假设，而非已确立的性质。 通过在金标准正确性上拟合各模型的 Platt 校准映射，异构辩论共识带来了超过 8 8 个百分点的提升，而各成员的准确率仍不均衡（附录 P）。

paragraphs.en: Alignment by Confident Debate (AbCD) constructs preference data from multi-agent debate traces. The framework clusters final answers by task-level equivalence and ranks the clusters using aggregate confidence on their claimed answer, converting debate disagreement into supervision compatible with standard post-training objectives. Across mathematical reasoning, question-answering, and coding benchmarks, our oracle selection identifies correct answer cluster more accurately than majority voting overall, with a larger advantage on disagreement and count-tie instances. Preference training on the resulting pairs improves over inference-only ensembling, inference-only debate, and SFT trained on the same traces, with the largest gains occurring when the inference-only committee has substantial headroom. However, heterogeneous committees expose a limitation of aggregating raw token-probability confidence across models, motivating future work on cross-model confidence calibration. These results indicate that combining task-level answer equivalence with confidence-weighted disagreement can turn multi-agent debate into a practical self-training signal, provided that outputs are parseable, a suitable equivalence procedure is available, and confidence is comparable across the committee.
paragraphs.zh: 置信辩论对齐（Alignment by Confident Debate, AbCD）从多智能体辩论轨迹中构建偏好数据。 该框架按任务级等价性对最终答案进行聚类，并使用各聚类所主张答案的聚合置信度对聚类进行排序，将辩论中的分歧转化为与标准后训练目标兼容的监督信号。 在数学推理、问答和代码基准测试中，我们的预言机选择总体上比多数投票更准确地识别出正确的答案聚类，在存在分歧和票数持平的样本上优势更大。 基于所得偏好对进行的偏好训练优于仅推理的集成方法、仅推理的辩论方法，以及在同一轨迹上训练的 SFT，且当仅推理的委员会尚有较大提升空间时收益最大。 然而，异构委员会暴露了跨模型聚合原始词元概率置信度的局限性，这为未来跨模型置信度校准的研究提供了动机。 这些结果表明，将任务级答案等价性与置信度加权的分歧相结合，可以把多智能体辩论转化为一种实用的自训练信号，前提是输出可解析、存在合适的等价性判定程序，且置信度在委员会内部具有可比性。

paragraphs.en: Self-consistency aggregates independent chains by majority vote when answers can be checked for equivalence ( Wang et al., 2022 ) . Universal self-consistency relaxes that requirement by asking a model which free-form samples are consistent ( Chen et al., 2023 ) . Multi-agent debate instead lets agents read one another across multiple rounds, and the group’s answer can be stronger than any single chain ( Du et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) . That gain is not automatic. Under homogeneous agents and unweighted belief updates, debate preserves expected correctness over time, so the protocol can underperform a vote over independent samples ( Choi et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Over rounds, repeated interaction can increase similarity among agents’ rationales, a failure mode termed representational collapse , so agreement can manufacture confidence while errors stay shared ( Dai, 2026 ) . The remaining uncertainty mixes epistemic disagreement with aleatoric decoding noise, and longer debates can let the latter flip a correct answer ( Qiao et al., 2026 ) . These results diagnose test-time debate. AbCD takes it as a constraint on the training oracle: consensus is an outcome of the protocol, so it cannot be the label.
paragraphs.zh: 自一致性（Self-consistency）在答案可以检验等价性时，通过多数投票聚合独立链（Wang et al., 2022）。 通用自一致性（Universal self-consistency）放宽了这一要求，让模型判断哪些自由格式的样本彼此一致（Chen et al., 2023）。 多智能体辩论则让智能体在多轮中互相阅读彼此，且群体的答案可以强于任何单条链（Du et al., 2023；Liang et al., 2024）。 这种收益并非自动获得。 在同质智能体和无加权信念更新的条件下，辩论会随时间保持期望正确率不变，因此该协议可能逊于对独立样本的投票（Choi et al., 2026；Zhu et al., 2026）。 随着轮次增加，反复交互会提高智能体之间理由的相似度，这种失败模式被称为表征坍缩（representational collapse），因而在错误保持共享的同时，一致性可能制造出虚假的信心（Dai, 2026）。 剩余的不确定性混合了认知分歧与偶然的解码噪声，而更长的辩论可能让后者翻转一个正确答案（Qiao et al., 2026）。 这些结果对测试时辩论做出了诊断。 AbCD 将其视为对训练监督信号的约束：共识是协议的产物，因此不能作为标签。

paragraphs.en: A natural alternative to vote count is the model’s own likelihood. Full-response likelihood is a coarse signal because it scores all generated tokens, including reasoning tokens that may be only weakly tied to final-answer correctness. CISC weights independent samples by verbalized confidence, P ⁡ ( true ) P(\mathrm{true}) , or sequence probability ( Taubenfeld et al., 2025 ) ; self-certainty uses the peakedness of the token distribution ( Kang et al., 2026 ) . Restricting the score to answer-relevant tokens such as numbers, entities, or choice letters ranks correctness better than scoring every token ( Razghandi et al., 2025 ) . In debate, length-normalized answer-token confidence, after calibration, can improve the committee’s answer selection ( Lin and Hooi, 2025 ) , and diversity-aware initialization combined with calibrated confidence communication can allow homogeneous debate to outperform majority vote ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . On open-ended debate without a reference answer, early-generation log-probabilities vary more across traces than the rest of the sequence and better predict judged quality ( Keramati et al., 2026 ) . Token probabilities are also a well-studied uncertainty signal more broadly ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Tian et al., 2023 ) . All of this work uses confidence to select an answer at inference time. AbCD uses span-level confidence to construct preferred and dispreferred traces for post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 投票计数的自然替代方案是模型自身的似然。 全响应似然是一种粗粒度的信号，因为它对所有生成的 token 打分，包括那些与最终答案正确性可能只有微弱关联的推理 token。 CISC 通过言语化置信度、P ⁡ ( true ) P(\mathrm{true}) 或序列概率对独立样本加权（ Taubenfeld et al., 2025 ）；self-certainty 则使用 token 分布的尖峰程度（ Kang et al., 2026 ）。 将打分限制在与答案相关的 token（如数字、实体或选项字母）上，比给每个 token 都打分更能有效地对正确性进行排序（ Razghandi et al., 2025 ）。 在辩论中，经过校准的长度归一化答案 token 置信度可以改进委员会的答案选择（ Lin and Hooi, 2025 ），而多样性感知的初始化结合经校准的置信度通信，可以使同质辩论优于多数投票（ Zhu et al., 2026 ）。 在没有参考答案的开放式辩论中，早期生成的对数概率在多条轨迹之间比序列其余部分的变异更大，并且能更好地预测评判出的质量（ Keramati et al., 2026 ）。 从更广泛的角度来看，token 概率也是一种已被充分研究的置信度信号（ Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Tian et al., 2023 ）。 所有这些工作都是在推理阶段用置信度来选择答案。 AbCD 使用片段级置信度来构建用于后训练的偏好与非偏好轨迹。

paragraphs.en: STaR and ReST fine-tune on traces that pass a verifier ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Gulcehre et al., 2023 ) . TTRL and related methods treat the majority among independent samples as a pseudo-label for GRPO or DPO ( Zuo et al., 2026 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) . Self-rewarding models and RLAIF replace the verifier with another language model ( Yuan et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2022 ) . Process reward models need step-level annotation ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) . These methods still rely on an external correctness signal from a checker, a judge, or an independent majority. AbCD stays in this family but derives its signal from a debating committee and from span-level likelihood, not from a gold answer, a judge, or vote count alone.
paragraphs.zh: STaR 和 ReST 在通过验证器的推理轨迹上进行微调（Zelikman et al., 2022；Gulcehre et al., 2023）。 TTRL 及相关方法将独立采样中的多数结果视为 GRPO 或 DPO 的伪标签（Zuo et al., 2026；Shao et al., 2024）。 自我奖励模型和 RLAIF 用另一个语言模型来替代验证器（Yuan et al., 2024；Bai et al., 2022）。 过程奖励模型需要步骤级别的标注（Lightman et al., 2024）。 这些方法仍然依赖来自检查器、评判器或独立多数投票的外部正确性信号。 AbCD 属于这一类方法，但其信号来自辩论委员会和跨度级别的似然，而非来自黄金答案、评判器或仅靠投票计数。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent interaction is increasingly used as a training corpus, not only as a test-time ensemble. One line of work imitates debate roles or consensus traces using SFT or GRPO ( Subramaniam et al., 2025 ; Srivastava et al., 2025 ) . Another turns majority versus minority traces, or debate-derived preference trees, into preference pairs ( Samanta et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) . A third jointly trains specialized agents in generate–verify–refine loops, student–teacher setups, or cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), typically against gold labels, a teacher model, or a shared task reward ( Motwani et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . AI-safety debate is a different setting: two agents argue for a human judge ( Irving et al., 2018 ) . What these methods share is how they name and weight the data. The winner is determined by vote count, a gold answer, or a teacher; every retained pair is treated equally; and the committee is typically composed of homogeneous clones, with diversity obtained only by training distinct roles rather than by scoring a diverse sample of a single policy. To our knowledge, prior debate-training methods do not construct preference pairs by ranking task-level answer-equivalence clusters using aggregate claimed answer-span confidence, or treat the degree of disagreement within the committee as a reliability weight rather than as the label. Unlike prior debate-based training methods that use vote count, a teacher, or a gold answer to assign labels, AbCD constructs preference data by combining task-level answer equivalence, span-confidence mass, and disagreement-based reliability weighting.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体交互日益被用作训练语料，而不仅仅作为测试时的集成方法。 一条研究路线使用 SFT 或 GRPO 来模仿辩论角色或共识轨迹（Subramaniam et al., 2025；Srivastava et al., 2025）。 另一条路线将多数与少数轨迹，或由辩论得到的偏好树，转化为偏好对（Samanta et al., 2025；Zhou et al., 2025）。 第三条路线在生成–验证–改进循环、师生设置或协作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）中联合训练专门的智能体，通常以金标准标签、教师模型或共享任务奖励作为监督（Motwani et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2026）。 AI 安全辩论是一个不同的场景：两个智能体为人类裁判进行辩论（Irving et al., 2018）。 这些方法的共同之处在于它们对数据的命名与加权方式。 胜者由票数、金标准答案或教师决定；每个被保留的偏好对都被同等对待；并且委员会通常由同质的克隆组成，多样性仅通过训练不同的角色获得，而不是通过对单一策略的多样化样本进行评分获得。 据我们所知，先前的辩论训练方法既没有通过使用聚合的声明答案片段置信度对任务级答案等价簇进行排序来构建偏好对，也没有将委员会内部的分歧程度作为可靠性权重而非标签来对待。 与先前使用票数、教师或金标准答案来分配标签的基于辩论的训练方法不同，AbCD 通过结合任务级答案等价性、片段置信度质量以及基于分歧的可靠性加权来构建偏好数据。

sents.en: Multi-agent interaction is increasingly used as a training corpus, not only as a test-time ensemble.
sents.zh: 多智能体交互日益被用作训练语料，而不仅仅作为测试时的集成方法。

sents.en: One line of work imitates debate roles or consensus traces using SFT or GRPO ( Subramaniam et al., 2025 ; Srivastava et al., 2025 ) .

sents.en: Another turns majority versus minority traces, or debate-derived preference trees, into preference pairs ( Samanta et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 另一条路线将多数与少数轨迹，或由辩论得到的偏好树，转化为偏好对（Samanta et al., 2025；Zhou et al., 2025）。

sents.en: A third jointly trains specialized agents in generate–verify–refine loops, student–teacher setups, or cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), typically against gold labels, a teacher model, or a shared task reward ( Motwani et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .

sents.en: AI-safety debate is a different setting: two agents argue for a human judge ( Irving et al., 2018 ) .
sents.zh: AI 安全辩论是一个不同的场景：两个智能体为人类裁判进行辩论（Irving et al., 2018）。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 outlines AbCD. For each prompt, a diverse committee debates for M M rounds; final answers are clustered by equivalence and ranked by confidence mass on the claimed answer-span. The winning cluster yields preferred completions, the rest dispreferred, and the agreement rate can be used as a soft reliability weight. We collect SFT and preference datasets from these traces and post-train the base policy with standard objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 概述了 AbCD。 对于每个提示，一个多样化的委员会进行 M 轮辩论；最终答案按等价性聚类，并按所声称答案片段上的置信度质量排序。 获胜的聚类产生偏好完成，其余的作为非偏好完成，一致率可用作软可靠性权重。 我们从这些轨迹中收集 SFT 数据集和偏好数据集，并使用标准目标对基础策略进行后训练。

sents.en: Algorithm 1 outlines AbCD.
sents.zh: 算法 1 概述了 AbCD。

sents.en: For each prompt, a diverse committee debates for M M rounds; final answers are clustered by equivalence and ranked by confidence mass on the claimed answer-span.
sents.zh: 对于每个提示，一个多样化的委员会进行 M 轮辩论；最终答案按等价性聚类，并按所声称答案片段上的置信度质量排序。

sents.en: The winning cluster yields preferred completions, the rest dispreferred, and the agreement rate can be used as a soft reliability weight.
sents.zh: 获胜的聚类产生偏好完成，其余的作为非偏好完成，一致率可用作软可靠性权重。

sents.en: We collect SFT and preference datasets from these traces and post-train the base policy with standard objectives.
sents.zh: 我们从这些轨迹中收集 SFT 数据集和偏好数据集，并使用标准目标对基础策略进行后训练。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate AbCD on four publicly available benchmarks spanning mathematical word problems, multiple-choice quantitative question answering, and Python code generation. GSM8K, SVAMP, and MathQA evaluate mathematical or quantitative reasoning; MBPP evaluates code generation with executable unit tests. Gold answers and full unit-test outcomes are used only for evaluation and reporting accuracy; they are not provided to the debate oracle or used as training labels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在四个公开可用的基准上评估 AbCD，这些基准涵盖数学应用题、多项选择定量问答以及 Python 代码生成。 GSM8K、SVAMP 和 MathQA 评估数学或定量推理；MBPP 通过可执行的单元测试评估代码生成。 标准答案和完整的单元测试结果仅用于评估和报告准确率；它们不会提供给辩论预言机，也不会用作训练标签。

sents.en: We evaluate AbCD on four publicly available benchmarks spanning mathematical word problems, multiple-choice quantitative question answering, and Python code generation.
sents.zh: 我们在四个公开可用的基准上评估 AbCD，这些基准涵盖数学应用题、多项选择定量问答以及 Python 代码生成。

sents.en: GSM8K, SVAMP, and MathQA evaluate mathematical or quantitative reasoning; MBPP evaluates code generation with executable unit tests.
sents.zh: GSM8K、SVAMP 和 MathQA 评估数学或定量推理；MBPP 通过可执行的单元测试评估代码生成。

sents.en: Gold answers and full unit-test outcomes are used only for evaluation and reporting accuracy; they are not provided to the debate oracle or used as training labels.
sents.zh: 标准答案和完整的单元测试结果仅用于评估和报告准确率；它们不会提供给辩论预言机，也不会用作训练标签。

paragraphs.en: GSM8K contains 8,500 grade-school mathematical word problems with natural-language solutions and numeric final answers ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) . It evaluates multi-step arithmetic reasoning in natural language. For AbCD, we parse and cluster the boxed numerical final answers produced by committee members.
paragraphs.zh: GSM8K 包含 8,500 道小学数学应用题，附有自然语言解答和数值最终答案（Cobbe et al., 2021）。 它评估自然语言中的多步算术推理能力。 对于 AbCD，我们对委员会成员给出的加框数值最终答案进行解析和聚类。

sents.en: GSM8K contains 8,500 grade-school mathematical word problems with natural-language solutions and numeric final answers ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) .
sents.zh: GSM8K 包含 8,500 道小学数学应用题，附有自然语言解答和数值最终答案（Cobbe et al., 2021）。

sents.en: It evaluates multi-step arithmetic reasoning in natural language.
sents.zh: 它评估自然语言中的多步算术推理能力。

sents.en: For AbCD, we parse and cluster the boxed numerical final answers produced by committee members.
sents.zh: 对于 AbCD，我们对委员会成员给出的加框数值最终答案进行解析和聚类。

paragraphs.en: SVAMP contains arithmetic word problems designed to test robustness to variations in linguistic form and problem structure ( Patel et al., 2021 ) . Its controlled perturbations reduce the usefulness of superficial shortcuts and emphasize the underlying arithmetic relations. As in GSM8K, committee members produce boxed numerical final answers.
paragraphs.zh: SVAMP 包含旨在测试对语言形式和问题结构变化鲁棒性的算术应用题（Patel et al., 2021）。 其受控的扰动降低了表面捷径的有效性，并强调底层的算术关系。 与 GSM8K 一样，委员会成员生成以方框标注的数值最终答案。

sents.en: SVAMP contains arithmetic word problems designed to test robustness to variations in linguistic form and problem structure ( Patel et al., 2021 ) .
sents.zh: SVAMP 包含旨在测试对语言形式和问题结构变化鲁棒性的算术应用题（Patel et al., 2021）。

sents.en: Its controlled perturbations reduce the usefulness of superficial shortcuts and emphasize the underlying arithmetic relations.
sents.zh: 其受控的扰动降低了表面捷径的有效性，并强调底层的算术关系。

sents.en: As in GSM8K, committee members produce boxed numerical final answers.
sents.zh: 与 GSM8K 一样，委员会成员生成以方框标注的数值最终答案。

paragraphs.en: MathQA is a large-scale quantitative reasoning benchmark containing natural-language questions paired with executable mathematical programs and multiple-choice answer options ( Amini et al., 2019 ) . We use it as a multiple-choice quantitative QA setting, where agents produce a final answer in the prescribed answer format and the oracle clusters answers by selected option equivalence.
paragraphs.zh: MathQA 是一个大规模定量推理基准，包含自然语言问题，并配有可执行的数学程序和多项选择题选项（Amini et al., 2019）。 我们将其用作多项选择定量问答的设置，其中智能体按规定答案格式给出最终答案，而裁判机制按所选选项等价性对答案进行聚类。

sents.en: MathQA is a large-scale quantitative reasoning benchmark containing natural-language questions paired with executable mathematical programs and multiple-choice answer options ( Amini et al., 2019 ) .
sents.zh: MathQA 是一个大规模定量推理基准，包含自然语言问题，并配有可执行的数学程序和多项选择题选项（Amini et al., 2019）。

sents.en: We use it as a multiple-choice quantitative QA setting, where agents produce a final answer in the prescribed answer format and the oracle clusters answers by selected option equivalence.
sents.zh: 我们将其用作多项选择定量问答的设置，其中智能体按规定答案格式给出最终答案，而裁判机制按所选选项等价性对答案进行聚类。

paragraphs.en: MBPP contains approximately 1,000 crowd-sourced Python problems intended to be solvable by entry-level programmers ( Austin et al., 2021 ) . Each example provides a natural-language specification, a reference function, a public test list, and an optional challenge list. A public test is an assertion of the form assert f ⁡ ( x ) = y f(x)=y . We parse each assertion into the arguments x x and the expected return value y y , execute the candidate agent response on x x , and mark the case passed when the returned value matches y y . Programs that emit the same sequence of public outputs, including the same exception type on a failing case, form one equivalence class. The execution oracle ranks a class by how many of these public cases its members pass. Challenge assertions are omitted from this trace, so they do not affect clustering or the training label.
paragraphs.zh: MBPP 包含大约 1,000 个由众包收集的 Python 问题，这些问题旨在让入门级程序员也能解决（Austin et al., 2021）。 每个样例提供一个自然语言规格说明、一个参考函数、一个公开测试列表以及一个可选的挑战列表。 公开测试是形如 assert f(x)=y 的断言。 我们将每个断言解析为参数 x 和期望返回值 y，在 x 上执行候选的智能体响应，当返回值与 y 匹配时将该用例标记为通过。 输出相同公开输出序列的程序，包括在失败用例上抛出相同异常类型的情况，构成一个等价类。 执行判定器根据该类成员通过多少个这些公开用例来对等价类进行排序。 挑战断言在此过程中被省略，因此它们不会影响聚类或训练标签。

paragraphs.en: The main paper we use tasks on which a final answer is a number, a choice letter, or a program, so two traces can be tested for equivalence and then counted. RaR-Medicine ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ) does not have that kind of answer. We use the medicine split of Rubrics as Rewards ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ) , released as ScaleAI/RaR-Medicine on Huggingface. Each example is a clinical question, a reference answer, and a checklist. A checklist is an ordered list of pass/fail criteria produced by the autorubric pipeline of Gunjal et al. (2026) . We used this dataset in appendix U .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主论文所使用的任务，其最终答案是一个数字、一个选项字母或一段程序，因此可以对两条轨迹进行等价性检验并加以统计。 RaR-Medicine（Gunjal 等，2026）没有这类答案。 我们使用 Rubrics as Rewards（Gunjal 等，2026）的医学划分，该数据集以 ScaleAI/RaR-Medicine 的名义发布在 Huggingface 上。 每个样例包含一个临床问题、一个参考答案和一个核查清单。 核查清单是由 Gunjal 等（2026）的 autorubric 流水线生成的按顺序排列的通过/不通过标准的列表。 我们在附录 U 中使用了该数据集。

paragraphs.en: The relation ≡ \equiv in Section 3.3 is computed entirely from the committee’s own outputs: it compares parsed candidate answers with one another and never receives the reference answer. A trace for which the parser 𝒜 ⁡ ( y ) \mathcal{A}(y) is undefined is excluded from clustering. On GSM8K and SVAMP, y ≡ y ′ y\equiv y^{\prime} when the numbers parsed from the final boxed spans denote the same value, so two derivations of the same quantity form one cluster regardless of wording. On MathQA, y ≡ y ′ y\equiv y^{\prime} when those spans name the same choice letter. On MBPP, y ≡ y ′ y\equiv y^{\prime} when both completions parse as programs, execute on the public tests, and return the same outputs; the public tests are not part of the generation prompt, and the hidden challenge tests are used only to score the selected program at evaluation. In all four tasks, ≡ \equiv is a relation on task outcomes, not on the text of the reasoning trace. But in RaR we used a Judge model to find the equivalence of free text generated by agents.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3.3 节中的关系 ≡ \equiv 完全由委员会自身的输出计算得出：它将解析出的候选答案相互比较，从不接收参考答案。 解析器 𝒜 ⁡ ( y ) \mathcal{A}(y) 无定义的轨迹将被排除在聚类之外。 在 GSM8K 和 SVAMP 上，当从最终 boxed 片段中解析出的数值相同（即值相同）时，y ≡ y ′ y\equiv y^{\prime}，因此无论措辞如何，同一数量的两种推导都会归为一个聚类。 在 MathQA 上，当这些片段指向同一选项字母时，y ≡ y ′ y\equiv y^{\prime}。 在 MBPP 上，当两个补全都可解析为程序、在公开测试上执行并返回相同输出时，y ≡ y ′ y\equiv y^{\prime}；公开测试不属于生成提示的一部分，隐藏的挑战测试仅用于在评估时对所选程序打分。 在所有四个任务中，≡ \equiv 是任务结果上的关系，而非推理轨迹文本上的关系。 但在 RaR 中，我们使用了一个 Judge 模型来判断智能体生成的自由文本之间的等价性。

paragraphs.en: The training label is a cluster of agent answers. The rule that decides which answers belong together, and the score that chooses the winning cluster, depend on the dataset. GSM8K and SVAMP are grade-school word problems with one numerical answer. MathQA is also a math problem, but the answer is a choice letter. On these three datasets every agent produces a short discrete answer, so confidence ensembling is an alternative to a majority vote. The same construction extends to domains without a single gold string. MBPP is execution. Programs that produce the same public outputs form one cluster, a vote is well-defined after that execution, and confidence is the number of public tests passed. RaR is free text. A judge marks the checklist, including penalty items with negative weight, and confidence is the weighted score of the marked items. Voting remains a baseline after the same clustering: on code it counts programs with the same public outputs, and on rubrics it counts copies of the same checklist. Table 7 lists the three groups.
paragraphs.zh: 训练标签是一组智能体答案构成的簇。 决定哪些答案归为一簇的规则，以及选出胜出簇的分数，都取决于数据集。 GSM8K 和 SVAMP 是只有一个数值答案的小学算术应用题。 MathQA 也是数学题，但答案是选项字母。 在这三个数据集上，每个智能体都会产生一个简短的离散答案，因此置信度集成是多数投票的一种替代方案。 同样的构造可以扩展到没有唯一标准字符串的领域。MBPP 采用执行结果。 产生相同公开输出的程序构成一个簇，执行之后投票就有了明确定义，置信度则是通过的公开测试数量。RaR 是自由文本。 评判者对检查清单进行打分，包括权重为负的扣分项，置信度是所勾选项的加权得分。 在同样的聚类之后，投票仍然是一个基线：在代码上它统计产生相同公开输出的程序数量，在评分标准上它统计相同检查清单的副本数量。 表 7 列出了这三个组。

paragraphs.en: All agents in a committee share the same base prompt for a given domain, with minor task-specific variants for math, multiple-choice QA, and coding. For math and QA tasks, the initial prompt instructs the model to provide a bullet-point summary of its step-by-step reasoning and to emit a final answer in the form a ​ n ​ s ​ w ​ e ​ r . For coding (MBPP), the prompt requests a single Python function in a fenced code block with no additional text. In each debate round, agents receive the other agents’ previous responses and are asked to update their reasoning or code accordingly, while preserving the same final-answer format.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个委员会中，所有智能体在给定领域共享相同的基础提示词，仅针对数学、多项选择问答和编码任务有少量特定任务的变体。 对于数学和问答任务，初始提示词指示模型提供其逐步推理的要点式总结，并以 a n s w e r 的形式给出最终答案。 对于编码（MBPP）任务，提示词要求在围栏代码块中给出单个 Python 函数，且不附加任何其他文本。 在每一轮辩论中，智能体会接收其他智能体先前的回答，并被要求相应地更新其推理或代码，同时保持相同的最终答案格式。

paragraphs.en: We additionally fix the committee size ( 5 5 ) and compare the effect of additional exchange rounds across model families on GSM8K (Figure 6 ). We observe similar behavior across other datasets (Figure 7 ). Across these settings, the first exchange round often improves consensus accuracy, whereas further rounds increase agreement without a corresponding improvement in correctness and can subsequently reduce consensus accuracy. This pattern is consistent with debate-induced correlation: later rounds make agents’ answers more alike without necessarily adding independent evidence for the correct answer.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还固定了委员会规模（5 5），并在 GSM8K 上比较了不同模型家族中增加交换轮次的效果（图 6）。 我们在其他数据集上观察到类似的行为（图 7）。 在这些设置下，第一轮交换通常会提升共识准确率，而后续轮次只是增加一致性却未相应提升正确性，随后还可能降低共识准确率。 这一模式与辩论引发的相关性相符：后续轮次使智能体的答案更加相似，但并不一定为正确答案补充独立的证据。

paragraphs.en: We further stratify oracle precision by agreement-rate. For a five-agent committee, an agreement rate of 2 / 5 2/5 means that two agents produce parseable final answers in the same answer-equivalence cluster; the remaining agents either support other clusters or produce unparseable answers. Precision is the fraction of oracle-selected answers that are correct within each agreement-rate bin, using reference answers only for evaluation. Across the evaluated models, later exchange rounds tend to reduce precision at several agreement levels, including partially split committees, despite increasing the frequency of high-agreement outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步按一致率对预言机精确率进行分层。 对于由五个智能体组成的委员会，2/5 的一致率意味着有两个智能体产生可解析的最终答案并落入同一个答案等价簇；其余智能体要么支持其他簇，要么产生无法解析的答案。 精确率是在每个一致率区间内，预言机所选答案中正确的比例，参考答案仅用于评估。 在所评估的模型中，尽管更高的轮次会增加高一致结果的出现频率，但在若干一致率水平上（包括委员会出现部分分裂的情况），后续的交流轮次往往会降低精确率。

paragraphs.en: To isolate the effect of committee diversity, we compare four configurations: (i) clones , which share temperature 0.01 0.01 ; (ii) temperature-diverse agents , which use temperatures { 0.01 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1.0 } \{0.01,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0\} across five agents; (iii) role-diverse agents , which use distinct system prompts at the same temperature 0.01 0.01 and (iv) seed-diverse agents , which use distinct sampling seeds at a shared temperature 0.01 0.01 . Table 8 reports the corresponding inference-only results. Across the evaluated models, the temperature-diverse committee achieves either the highest or second-highest consensus accuracy. We therefore use it as the default committee configuration for the experiments in Section 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了隔离委员会多样性的影响，我们比较了四种配置：(i) 克隆智能体（clones），它们共享温度 0.01 0.01；(ii) 温度多样智能体（temperature-diverse agents），五个智能体分别使用温度 { 0.01 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1.0 } \{0.01,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0\}；(iii) 角色多样智能体（role-diverse agents），在相同温度 0.01 0.01 下使用不同的系统提示词；以及 (iv) 种子多样智能体（seed-diverse agents），在共享温度 0.01 0.01 下使用不同的采样种子。 表 8 报告了相应的仅推理（inference-only）结果。 在所有被评估的模型上，温度多样委员会都取得了最高或次高的共识准确率。 因此，我们将其作为第 4 节实验的默认委员会配置。

paragraphs.en: This section summarizes the training and generation configuration for all reported results. All runs use 4-bit QLoRA on the attention projection modules { q , k , v , o } proj \{q,k,v,o\}_{\mathrm{proj}} , with rank r = 32 r{=}32 , α = 64 \alpha{=}64 , dropout 0.1 0.1 , and a single post-training iteration from the instruction-tuned checkpoint. Unless otherwise noted, experiments use seed 10 10 ; ablations in Section 5 average over three seeds. Gold labels and unit-test outcomes are never provided to the oracle or to the standard training objectives; they are used only for evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 本节总结了所有已报告结果的训练与生成配置。 所有运行均在注意力投影模块 { q , k , v , o } proj \{q,k,v,o\}_{\mathrm{proj}} 上使用 4 位 QLoRA，秩 r = 32 r{=}32，α = 64 \alpha{=}64，dropout 为 0.1 0.1，并从指令微调检查点出发进行单次训练后迭代。 除非另有说明，实验均使用种子 10 10；第 5 节中的消融实验对三个种子取平均。 金标准标签与单元测试结果从不提供给 oracle 或标准训练目标；它们仅用于评估。

sents.en: This section summarizes the training and generation configuration for all reported results.
sents.zh: 本节总结了所有已报告结果的训练与生成配置。

sents.en: All runs use 4-bit QLoRA on the attention projection modules { q , k , v , o } proj \{q,k,v,o\}_{\mathrm{proj}} , with rank r = 32 r{=}32 , α = 64 \alpha{=}64 , dropout 0.1 0.1 , and a single post-training iteration from the instruction-tuned checkpoint.
sents.zh: 所有运行均在注意力投影模块 { q , k , v , o } proj \{q,k,v,o\}_{\mathrm{proj}} 上使用 4 位 QLoRA，秩 r = 32 r{=}32，α = 64 \alpha{=}64，dropout 为 0.1 0.1，并从指令微调检查点出发进行单次训练后迭代。

sents.en: Unless otherwise noted, experiments use seed 10 10 ; ablations in Section 5 average over three seeds.
sents.zh: 除非另有说明，实验均使用种子 10 10；第 5 节中的消融实验对三个种子取平均。

sents.en: Gold labels and unit-test outcomes are never provided to the oracle or to the standard training objectives; they are used only for evaluation.
sents.zh: 金标准标签与单元测试结果从不提供给 oracle 或标准训练目标；它们仅用于评估。

paragraphs.en: DPO pairs are formed as the Cartesian product 𝒢 + ​ ( x ) × 𝒢 − ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{+}(x)\times\mathcal{G}^{-}(x) after discarding prompts with an empty preferred or dispreferred set. Unanimous debates (where 𝒢 − ​ ( x ) = ∅ \mathcal{G}^{-}(x)=\emptyset ) may still contribute 𝒢 + ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{+}(x) to the SFT dataset. Preference datasets do not include the previous-round peer context; debate itself uses peer context.

paragraphs.en: Columns are organized as follows: “Ensemble” and “Debate” are inference-only baselines (no post-training); “SFT” fine-tunes on the preferred completions 𝒢 + ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{+}(x) ; “DPO” and “KTO” use the oracle-derived preference labels, while “GRPO” uses the oracle-derived reward as described in Section 4 . paragraphs.en: KTO assigns desirable or undesirable labels to individual completions rather than explicitly contrasting competing completions for the same prompt. It therefore uses the oracle labels without directly encoding the pairwise relation between traces in 𝒢 + ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{+}(x) and 𝒢 − ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{-}(x) . KTO nevertheless improves mean agent accuracy in many settings, indicating that the oracle-derived labels remain useful without explicit pairwise comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: KTO 为单个补全赋予合意或不合意的标签，而不是显式对比同一提示下的相互竞争的补全。 因此，它直接使用预言机标签，而不在 𝒢+​(x) 与 𝒢−​(x) 中直接编码轨迹之间的成对关系。 尽管如此，KTO 在许多设置中仍能提升智能体的平均准确率，这表明即便没有显式的成对比较，由预言机导出的标签依然有用。

paragraphs.en: where α ⁡ ( x ) \alpha(x) is a reliability weight. Because GRPO computes relative advantages within each newly sampled group, groups whose members receive identical rewards provide no within-group ranking signal under the standard formulation. Thus, unlike DPO, GRPO does not directly contrast the oracle-selected and competing debate traces during optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 其中 α ⁡ ( x ) \alpha(x) 是可靠性权重。 由于 GRPO 在每个新采样的组内计算相对优势，在标准公式下，成员获得完全相同奖励的组不会提供组内排序信号。 因此，与 DPO 不同，GRPO 在优化过程中并不直接对比神谕选择的辩论轨迹与竞争性辩论轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Official train split of 374 374 problems; 200 200 test problems subsampled from the official test set. Generation uses the task description only. The training oracle then clusters parseable programs by their public-test outputs and scores a cluster by how many public cases its members pass. Challenge assertions are withheld from that oracle. The reported correctness check executes every public assertion together with any challenge assertion, and it passes only when all of them succeed. The challenge list may be empty, in which case the check repeats the public assertions but remains all-or-nothing, whereas the oracle still counts how many public cases passed. Table 2 reports the polled overall public and hidden test cases passed for test-set by all the agents of the committee.
paragraphs.zh: 官方训练集划分包含 374 374 道题目；从官方测试集中子采样出 200 200 道测试题目。 生成仅使用任务描述。 训练预言机随后按可解析程序在公开测试上的输出对其进行聚类，并根据簇内成员通过的公开用例数量为每个簇打分。 挑战断言不会提供给该预言机。 所报告的正确性检查会执行每一条公开断言以及所有挑战断言，只有全部通过才算通过。 挑战列表可以为空，此时该检查会重复执行公开断言，但仍然采用全有或全无的判定方式，而预言机仍会统计通过的公开用例数量。 表 2 报告了委员会的所有智能体在测试集上通过的总计公开测试用例和隐藏测试用例数量。

paragraphs.en: It allows several moderately confident agents to outweigh a single highly confident outlier, while still allowing two highly confident agents to outweigh several weakly confident agents. By contrast, mean confidence normalizes away cluster size. For example, a singleton with confidence 0.95 0.95 would defeat a four-agent cluster whose members each have confidence 0.80 0.80 , because 0.95 > 0.80 0.95>0.80 , despite the latter cluster containing substantially more independent agreement. Mean confidence can therefore treat a singleton as equivalent to a crowd and make cluster size contribute only indirectly through the tie-break. It is also sensitive to miscalibration: an overconfident incorrect answer can dominate under mean aggregation, whereas sum aggregation requires its confidence to outweigh the accumulated confidence of the competing cluster. Figure 8 visualizes the corresponding accuracy trends for the two aggregation rules. Table 15 alongside motivate the use of confidence mass as the default aggregation rule in AbCD. Both the debate and post-trained checkpoint consensus accuracy are better in aggregation by sum compared to mean.

paragraphs.en: We compare majority voting (MV) with span-confidence selection on identical debate transcripts before any post-training. For each model–dataset pair, both rules operate on the same sampled responses and answer-equivalence clusters; gold labels are used only to evaluate the selected answer. Span denotes the accuracy of the cluster selected by aggregate claimed-answer-span confidence, while MV denotes the accuracy of the cluster selected by majority vote. paragraphs.en: On GSM8K, the two rules disagree on only 2.6 % 2.6\% of examples on average across the four models, and their overall selection accuracies are similar ( 57.5 % 57.5\% for span confidence and 57.2 % 57.2\% for MV). The difference is larger on cases where the rules disagree: the span-selected cluster is correct on 31.4 % 31.4\% of such cases, compared with 7.8 % 7.8\% for MV. Span confidence also achieves higher accuracy on count-tie cases ( 29.8 % 29.8\% vs. 18.3 % 18.3\% ). Across SVAMP and MathQA, the same analysis shows that the relative advantage is dataset- and model-dependent. Overall, Span confidence is most useful precisely when majority voting is ambiguous or the two rules disagree.
paragraphs.zh: 在 GSM8K 上，这两条规则在四个模型中平均仅有 2.6% 2.6\% 的样本上不一致，且它们的总体选择准确率相近（跨度置信度为 57.5% 57.5\%，MV 为 57.2% 57.2\%）。 在两条规则不一致的情形下差异更大：在 таких情形中，跨度选择所得到的聚类有 31.4% 31.4\% 是正确的，而 MV 仅为 7.8% 7.8\%。 跨度置信度在计数并列的样本上也取得了更高的准确率（29.8% 29.8\% 对 18.3% 18.3\%）。 在 SVAMP 和 MathQA 上，同样的分析表明这种相对优势依赖于数据集和模型。 总体而言，恰恰在多数投票结果不明确或两条规则不一致时，跨度置信度最有用。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation has several limitations that bound the conclusions supported by the experiments. Most main-grid cells use two post-training runs, while oracle and weighting ablations use three seeds where explicitly reported; these repetitions provide limited evidence about variance and statistical significance. We evaluate on subsets of the available training and test splits rather than the full datasets, limiting the precision with which the reported improvements characterize performance on the complete benchmarks. Post-training is restricted to a single iteration from each instruction-tuned checkpoint with QLoRA, so the experiments do not establish whether the observed gains persist under longer or repeated self-training. The maximum generation length of 256 256 tokens can truncate reasoning or final-answer spans, with truncation effects particularly visible for Llama-3.2-1B-it on GSM8K. Although the oracle uses no gold labels for supervision, it requires task-specific answer parsing and an equivalence relation, making the approach less directly applicable to outputs for which correctness cannot be parsed or reliably compared. The reported code-generation extension uses execution-based equivalence and therefore does not establish applicability to arbitrary open-ended generation without an executable correctness criterion. Answer-span confidence is computed from token probabilities and is not calibrated against correctness; the method therefore assumes that these probabilities provide a sufficiently informative within-committee ranking signal. Confidence scores are not recalibrated across heterogeneous architectures, and the heterogeneous-committee results show that raw token probabilities need not be directly comparable across models. The confidence oracle is evaluated against gold answers only retrospectively to measure selection quality; these labels are never available during oracle construction or post-training, so the experiments establish empirical utility rather than a guarantee that the oracle identifies the correct cluster. Finally, the experiments cover five instruction-tuned model families and four primary datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估存在若干局限性，这些局限性限定了实验所能支持的结论。 大多数主网格单元使用两次后训练运行，而显式报告的oracle与加权消融实验使用三个随机种子；这些重复运行仅能为方差和统计显著性提供有限的证据。 我们在可用训练集和测试集的子集上而非完整数据集上进行评估，这限制了所报告的改进对完整基准性能刻画的精确度。 后训练被限制为从每个指令微调检查点出发使用QLoRA进行单次迭代，因此实验并未确立所观察到的增益在更长或重复的自我训练下是否持续存在。 最大生成长度为256 256个token，这可能会截断推理或最终答案片段，截断效应在GSM8K上的Llama-3.2-1B-it中尤为明显。 尽管oracle不使用任何金标准标签进行监督，但它需要任务特定的答案解析和等价关系，这使得该方法难以直接应用于无法解析或无法可靠比较正确性的输出。 所报告的代码生成扩展使用基于执行的等价性，因此并未确立该方法在缺乏可执行正确性标准的情况下对任意开放式生成的适用性。 答案片段置信度基于token概率计算，且未针对正确性进行校准；因此该方法假设这些概率能够提供足够有效的委员会内部排序信号。 置信度分数未在不同异构架构之间进行重新校准，而异构委员会的结果表明，原始token概率在不同模型之间未必可直接比较。 置信度oracle仅以回顾方式针对金标准答案进行评估以衡量选择质量；这些标签在oracle构建或后训练过程中始终不可用，因此实验所确立的是经验性效用，而非oracle能够识别正确聚类的保证。 最后，实验涵盖五个指令微调模型系列和四个主要数据集。

sents.en: Our evaluation has several limitations that bound the conclusions supported by the experiments.
sents.zh: 我们的评估存在若干局限性，这些局限性限定了实验所能支持的结论。

sents.en: Most main-grid cells use two post-training runs, while oracle and weighting ablations use three seeds where explicitly reported; these repetitions provide limited evidence about variance and statistical significance.
sents.zh: 大多数主网格单元使用两次后训练运行，而显式报告的oracle与加权消融实验使用三个随机种子；这些重复运行仅能为方差和统计显著性提供有限的证据。

sents.en: We evaluate on subsets of the available training and test splits rather than the full datasets, limiting the precision with which the reported improvements characterize performance on the complete benchmarks.
sents.zh: 我们在可用训练集和测试集的子集上而非完整数据集上进行评估，这限制了所报告的改进对完整基准性能刻画的精确度。

sents.en: Post-training is restricted to a single iteration from each instruction-tuned checkpoint with QLoRA, so the experiments do not establish whether the observed gains persist under longer or repeated self-training.
sents.zh: 后训练被限制为从每个指令微调检查点出发使用QLoRA进行单次迭代，因此实验并未确立所观察到的增益在更长或重复的自我训练下是否持续存在。

sents.en: The maximum generation length of 256 256 tokens can truncate reasoning or final-answer spans, with truncation effects particularly visible for Llama-3.2-1B-it on GSM8K.
sents.zh: 最大生成长度为256 256个token，这可能会截断推理或最终答案片段，截断效应在GSM8K上的Llama-3.2-1B-it中尤为明显。

sents.en: Although the oracle uses no gold labels for supervision, it requires task-specific answer parsing and an equivalence relation, making the approach less directly applicable to outputs for which correctness cannot be parsed or reliably compared.
sents.zh: 尽管oracle不使用任何金标准标签进行监督，但它需要任务特定的答案解析和等价关系，这使得该方法难以直接应用于无法解析或无法可靠比较正确性的输出。

sents.en: The reported code-generation extension uses execution-based equivalence and therefore does not establish applicability to arbitrary open-ended generation without an executable correctness criterion.
sents.zh: 所报告的代码生成扩展使用基于执行的等价性，因此并未确立该方法在缺乏可执行正确性标准的情况下对任意开放式生成的适用性。

sents.en: Answer-span confidence is computed from token probabilities and is not calibrated against correctness; the method therefore assumes that these probabilities provide a sufficiently informative within-committee ranking signal.
sents.zh: 答案片段置信度基于token概率计算，且未针对正确性进行校准；因此该方法假设这些概率能够提供足够有效的委员会内部排序信号。

sents.en: Confidence scores are not recalibrated across heterogeneous architectures, and the heterogeneous-committee results show that raw token probabilities need not be directly comparable across models.
sents.zh: 置信度分数未在不同异构架构之间进行重新校准，而异构委员会的结果表明，原始token概率在不同模型之间未必可直接比较。

sents.en: The confidence oracle is evaluated against gold answers only retrospectively to measure selection quality; these labels are never available during oracle construction or post-training, so the experiments establish empirical utility rather than a guarantee that the oracle identifies the correct cluster.
sents.zh: 置信度oracle仅以回顾方式针对金标准答案进行评估以衡量选择质量；这些标签在oracle构建或后训练过程中始终不可用，因此实验所确立的是经验性效用，而非oracle能够识别正确聚类的保证。

sents.en: Finally, the experiments cover five instruction-tuned model families and four primary datasets.
sents.zh: 最后，实验涵盖五个指令微调模型系列和四个主要数据集。

paragraphs.en: Phi-4-mini-3.8B-it reaches 88.6 % 88.6\% on GSM8K and 88.2 % 88.2\% on SVAMP under independent sampling, and the best gain over debate is 0.7 0.7 pp and 0.3 0.3 pp (Table 1 ). On MathQA the same checkpoint moves from 41.6 % 41.6\% after debate to 59.5 % 59.5\% after DPO. The small GSM8K movement is the behavior of a model with little remaining headroom on that benchmark due to overfitting on the test set. Earlier work ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) find that earlier Phi releases score higher on GSM8K than on GSM1k, a held-out set matched to GSM8K in difficulty, which is consistent with partial familiarity with GSM8K-style items. MathQA is the dataset on which this checkpoint’s base accuracy leaves room to observe the oracle.

paragraphs.en: For Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it on GSM8K, consensus accuracy moves from 66.0 % 66.0\% to 70.4 % 70.4\% at iteration 1 1 and is 69.8 % 69.8\% at iteration 4 4 . Pre-debate agent accuracy on that pair moves from 24.0 % 24.0\% to 39.8 % 39.8\% at iteration 1 1 and does not move further. For Llama-3.2-1B-it on GSM8K, consensus accuracy peaks at iteration 1 1 ( 23.6 % 23.6\% ) and is lower at iterations 2 2 and 3 3 . Llama-3.2-1B-it on MathQA is the exception among these four rows: consensus accuracy continues from 7.4 % 7.4\% at iteration 1 1 to 10.2 % 10.2\% at iteration 4 4 , still on a low base. Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it on MathQA peaks at iteration 2 2 ( 55.0 % 55.0\% ) and falls to 49.8 % 49.8\% at iteration 4 4 , which is below its iteration- 1 1 consensus accuracy. Repeated self-training therefore does not produce a consistent further gain after the first iteration on these splits. The single-iteration protocol in the main experiments is the setting in which the measured improvement appears.

paragraphs.en: On GSM8K, raising the cap from 256 256 to 512 512 tokens raises inference-only debate from 66.0 % 66.0\% to 70.8 % 70.8\% , and raises independent-sampling consensus from 44.5 % 44.5\% to 49.5 % 49.5\% . The 256 256 -token debate baseline is therefore partly a property of the generation budget, not only of the committee. Preference post-training still improves on the longer budget: KTO reaches 75.4 % 75.4\% , which is + 4.6 p ​ p +4.6_{pp} over the 512 512 -token debate baseline, compared with + 5.4 p ​ p +5.4_{pp} for the best objective under the 256 256 -token cap. SFT remains within 0.2 p ​ p 0.2_{pp} of debate at both caps on this dataset ( 66.3 % 66.3\% and 71.0 % 71.0\% ). The longer budget changes which preference objective is best in the point estimate, from DPO at 256 256 tokens to KTO at 512 512 tokens.

paragraphs.en: The closest post-training use of debate traces labels a completion by vote count. Multi-Agent Consensus Alignment treats traces whose final answer matches the majority answer as preferred and the dissenting traces as dispreferred, then applies SFT, DPO, KTO, or a majority-vote reward under GRPO ( Samanta et al., 2025 ) . AbCD uses the same preference objectives and the same requirement that a prompt contribute to DPO or KTO only when both a preferred and a dispreferred set exist. The difference is the rule that fills those sets. MACA uses k maj = arg ​ max k ⁡ n k k_{\mathrm{maj}}=\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{k}n_{k} . AbCD uses k ⋆ = arg ​ max k ⁡ ( w k , n k ) k^{\star}=\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{k}(w_{k},n_{k}) , where w k w_{k} is the sum of claimed answer-Span-confidences in the cluster (Section 3.3 ). Agreement rate does not choose k ⋆ k^{\star} .
paragraphs.zh: 最接近的训练后应用做法是使用辩论轨迹，通过票数对补全进行标注。 多智能体共识对齐将最终答案与多数答案一致的轨迹视为偏好轨迹，将持异议的轨迹视为非偏好轨迹，然后应用 SFT、DPO、KTO 或 GRPO 下的多数票奖励（Samanta et al., 2025）。 AbCD 使用相同的偏好目标函数，并有相同的要求：只有当偏好集合和非偏好集合都存在时，一条提示才能贡献给 DPO 或 KTO。 区别在于填充这些集合的规则。 MACA 使用 k maj = arg ​ max k ⁡ n k k_{\mathrm{maj}}=\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{k}n_{k} 。 AbCD 使用 k ⋆ = arg ​ max k ⁡ ( w k , n k ) k^{\star}=\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{k}(w_{k},n_{k}) ，其中 w k w_{k} 是该簇中声称的答案-跨度置信度之和（第 3.3 节）。 一致率并不用于选择 k ⋆ k^{\star} 。

paragraphs.en: Table 21 compares majority-vote and span-confidence oracle pipelines on GSM8K and MathQA using Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it and Gemma-3-4B-it. For each model–dataset setting, both pipelines use the same source debate transcripts and the same objective-specific training hyperparameters. The only change from row to row is whether 𝒢 + ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{+}(x) is the majority cluster or the span-confidence cluster. Both labeling rules raise the best post-training consensus over the shared debate baseline. Span-confidence achieves higher best post-training consensus accuracy in all four model-dataset settings. For Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it, the best scores increase from 70.8 70.8 to 71.4 71.4 on GSM8K and from 47.4 47.4 to 53.7 53.7 on MathQA. For Gemma-3-4B-it, they increase from 66.8 66.8 to 72.7 72.7 and from 20.2 20.2 to 21.5 21.5 , respectively. The advantage is not uniform across training objectives. For example, majority-labeled KTO outperforms span-labeled KTO on Qwen GSM8K, while majority-labeled SFT outperforms span-labeled SFT on Gemma GSM8K. These results support span-confidence as a competitive oracle pipeline, while showing that its benefits depend on the model, dataset, and post-training objective.

Span-confidence at test time is the more accurate readout in every cell. On one of the runs (quoted in Table 22 ) the best accuracy is 71.6%, reached by DPO trained on Span-confidence.

paragraphs.en: Section 4.4 fits SFT, DPO, KTO, and GRPO on traces collected after one independent-sample generation followed by one exchange round. In this section we replace that collection with only independent-samples of the same policy and keeps every other choice fixed. The model is Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it, the dataset is GSM8K, and both pipelines use N = 5 N{=}5 temperature-diverse agents, and same training setup. The independent-sample pipeline stops after the initial generation. Test consensus is the accuracy of the span-selected cluster. Gold answers are used only for evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Section 5 shows that token-probability confidence is not comparable across architectures. Answer-span confidence c i span c_{i}^{\mathrm{span}} in Eq. equation 2 is a length-normalized geometric mean of token probabilities. It is an approximation of probability of correctness, and models with different tokenizers do not place it on a common scale. In the heterogeneous committee the oracle sums those scores, w k = ∑ i ∈ ℐ k c i span w_{k}=\sum_{i\in\mathcal{I}_{k}}c_{i}^{\mathrm{span}} . A member whose raw scores sit higher can then dominate a ^ ​ ( x ) \hat{a}(x) . This section fits a separate map for each architecture and applies it before that sum, both for the inference-only oracle and for the preference partition used by DPO.
paragraphs.zh: 第5节表明，词元概率置信度在不同架构之间不可比较。 式（公式2）中的答案片段置信度 c i span c_{i}^{\mathrm{span}} 是词元概率的长度归一化几何平均。 它是正确概率的一种近似，而使用不同分词器的模型不会将其置于同一尺度上。 在异构委员会中，oracle 对这些分数求和，w k = ∑ i ∈ ℐ k c i span w_{k}=\sum_{i\in\mathcal{I}_{k}}c_{i}^{\mathrm{span}} 。 原始分数偏高的成员因此可能在 a ^ ​ ( x ) \hat{a}(x) 中占据主导。 本节为每种架构拟合一个单独的映射，并在求和之前应用该映射，既用于仅推理的 oracle，也用于 DPO 所使用的偏好划分。

paragraphs.en: The coefficients ( a m , b m ) (a_{m},b_{m}) are an unpenalized logistic regression of gold correctness on the raw span score. The regression is fit on the heterogeneous committee itself: five members, M = 2 M{=}2 , one independent generation and one exchange, on GSM8K. The official training set is shuffled with the paper data seed. The paper training prefix is excluded. The next 2,000 2{,}000 training questions are the calibration pool. The uncalibrated committee uses the paper cap of 256 256 new tokens. Under that cap, Qwen3-1.7B-it (Q2) often ends before a parseable answer span, so its final-round trace contributes neither a cluster member nor a span score. For the calibration pool, the cap is raised to 512 512 new tokens. Every member then has room to finish the reasoning and emit the claimed answer before c i span c_{i}^{\mathrm{span}} is computed and before the Platt map is fit or applied. The score in the regression is the final-round span confidence, after the exchange. Unparseable traces are dropped. The larger of the correct and incorrect classes is downsampled to the smaller class, and 80 % 80\% of each class is used to fit ( a m , b m ) (a_{m},b_{m}) . The remaining 20 % 20\% is not used for the coefficients. Gold labels on this pool supervise only the logistic regression. They are not preference targets. Because the fitted map is the weight inside w k = ∑ i c ~ i w_{k}=\sum_{i}\tilde{c}_{i} , those labels do determine which cluster becomes 𝒢 + ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{+}(x) . The same protocol is run once for each of the five architectures. At test time, and again inside the DPO run, each member uses its own ( a m , b m ) (a_{m},b_{m}) .
paragraphs.zh: 系数 ( a m , b m ) (a_{m},b_{m}) 是以原始片段得分为自变量、以黄金正确性为因变量的无惩罚逻辑回归。 该回归拟合在异构委员会本身上：五个成员，M = 2 M{=}2，一次独立生成和一次交换，在 GSM8K 上进行。 官方训练集按论文数据种子打乱。 排除论文所用的训练前缀。 接下来的 2,000 2{,}000 道训练题构成校准池。 未校准的委员会使用论文设定的 256 256 个新 token 上限。 在该上限下，Qwen3-1.7B-it（Q2）常常在输出可解析答案片段之前就结束，因此其最终轮轨迹既不作为聚类成员，也不贡献片段得分。 对于校准池，上限提高到 512 512 个新 token。 这样每个成员都有空间完成推理并在计算 c i span c_{i}^{\mathrm{span}} 之前、在拟合或应用 Platt 映射之前给出所声称的答案。 回归中的得分是交换之后的最终轮片段置信度。 无法解析的轨迹被丢弃。 正确类与错误类中较大的一类被下采样到较小一类的规模，每类的 80 % 80\% 用于拟合 ( a m , b m ) (a_{m},b_{m})。 剩余的 20 % 20\% 不用于求系数。 该池上的黄金标签仅用于监督逻辑回归。 它们不是偏好目标。 由于拟合出的映射是 w k = ∑ i c ~ i w_{k}=\sum_{i}\tilde{c}_{i} 内部的权重，这些标签确实决定了哪个聚类成为 𝒢 + ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{+}(x)。 相同的流程对五个架构各运行一次。 在测试时，以及 DPO 运行内部，每个成员都使用自己的 ( a m , b m ) (a_{m},b_{m})。

paragraphs.en: Table 24 compares the uncalibrated heterogeneous committee with a committee that uses the fitted maps. On consensus accuracy, Platt-Debate reaches 88.0 % 88.0\% , against 79.2 % 79.2\% for Raw-Debate ( + 8.8 p ​ p +8.8_{pp} ). Platt-DPO reaches 89.6 % 89.6\% , against 87.0 % 87.0\% for Raw-DPO ( + 2.6 p ​ p +2.6_{pp} ). The larger share of the consensus change is already present before post-training. DPO then adds 1.6 p ​ p 1.6_{pp} of consensus accuracy on the calibrated committee, compared with 7.8 p ​ p 7.8_{pp} on the raw committee, where the inference-only baseline is lower. The map rescales span scores after the traces have been generated, so the consensus column is the quantity it changes: a different weighting can select a different cluster from the same five answers. Read against its own debate baseline, Platt-DPO raises mean agent accuracy from 61.6 % 61.6\% to 75.7 % 75.7\% . Across the two DPO rows, L1 is the exception: Raw-DPO reaches 71.0 % 71.0\% and Platt-DPO reaches 68.0 % 68.0\% . The calibrated committee still leaves a wide gap between consensus and the weaker members. At Platt-Debate, consensus accuracy is 88.0 % 88.0\% while L1 is at 27.6 % 27.6\% and P4 is at 83.2 % 83.2\% . Putting the five scores through separate logistic maps improves the selected answer on test split, and the members remain uneven.

paragraphs.en: To contextualize the performance of the local debate agents, we evaluate larger and closed-source models in a zero-shot, single-agent setting. All runs use temperature 0 0 and a maximum completion budget of 256 256 tokens, matching the generation budget per response used by the local debate agents.
paragraphs.zh: 为了给本地辩论智能体的性能提供参照背景，我们在零样本、单智能体设置下评估了更大规模的闭源模型。 所有运行均使用温度 0 0 以及 256 256 词元的最大生成预算，与本地辩论智能体所使用的每次回复生成预算保持一致。
