paragraphs.en: Table 25 separates responses into three categories: correct , when the extracted answer matches the reference answer; wrong , when an answer is extracted but does not match; and unparseable , when no valid final answer can be extracted. Unparseable responses are counted as incorrect when computing accuracy. This breakdown distinguishes answer errors from failures to produce a parseable final answer within the prescribed budget. The results characterize performance under this constrained generation protocol, rather than performance with unrestricted generation.
paragraphs.zh: 表25将回复分为三类：correct（正确），即提取的答案与参考答案一致；wrong（错误），即提取出了答案但不匹配；unparseable（不可解析），即无法提取出有效的最终答案。 在计算准确率时，不可解析的回复计为错误。 这一细分将答案错误与在规定预算内未能生成可解析的最终答案的情况区分开来。 这些结果刻画的是在该受限生成协议下的性能，而非不受限制生成时的性能。

paragraphs.en: We also studied the impact of a closed-source Judge model used for supervision for the oracle selection. We used GPT-4o model as judge for the multi-agent tempertaure diverse committee of five Qwen2.5-1.5B-it models, debating for two rounds. GPT-4o does not debate. After the second round it reads the question and the parsed final answer, and returns a probability that the answer is correct. It does not see the gold label or the other agents. Equivalent answers form a cluster, and the cluster score is the sum of those probabilities. A failed judge call contributes zero. The winning cluster supplies the DPO labels: its members are preferred, and the other parsed answers are dispreferred. Majority vote and the gold cluster are stored on the same generations. The gold cluster is the correct answer when any debater produced it.

paragraphs.en: Following the MBPP setup above in Appendix C , each candidate program is scored on the public assertions. Programs that emit the same sequence of public outputs form one cluster. Majority voting selects the largest cluster. Execution confidence selects the cluster whose members pass the most public cases, summing those passes across the agents that share the cluster. The reported correctness check is separate from that selection. It executes every public assertion together with any challenge assertion, and it passes only when all of them succeed (Hidden success-rate). The challenge list may be empty, in which case the check repeats the public assertions but remains all-or-nothing, whereas the oracle still counts how many public cases passed. A non-empty challenge assertion can reject a program that passed every public case. The hidden check is stricter than the public pass-rate even when the two sets of assertions coincide.
paragraphs.zh: 按照上文附录 C 中的 MBPP 设置，每个候选程序根据公开断言进行评分。 产生相同公开输出序列的程序归为一个簇。 多数投票选择最大的簇。 执行置信度选择其成员通过最多公开用例的簇，并将共享该簇的各智能体的通过数相加。 所报告的正确性检查与该选择过程是分开的。 它会执行所有公开断言以及任何挑战断言，只有当全部成功时才通过（Hidden success-rate）。 挑战列表可能为空，此时该检查会重复公开断言，但仍保持全有或全无，而 oracle 仍会统计通过了多少公开用例。 非空的挑战断言可以拒绝一个通过了所有公开用例的程序。 即使两组断言完全相同，隐藏检查也比公开通过率更严格。

paragraphs.en: We train Llama-3.1-8B with DPO for three epochs on shared five-agent debate. One run uses the majority cluster as the training label. The other uses the execution-confidence cluster. Figure 9 reports the hidden-check pass rate and the public-case pass rate of the winning cluster on the 200-question test set, before training and after DPO. The debate bars are the two selectors applied to the same traces. The DPO bars are each trained model scored by the selector it was trained on.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 DPO 在共享五智能体辩论上对 Llama-3.1-8B 进行三个 epoch 的训练。 一种运行方式使用多数簇作为训练标签。 另一种使用执行置信度簇。 图 9 报告了获胜簇在 200 道题测试集上训练前和 DPO 训练后的隐藏测试用例通过率与公开用例通过率。 辩论柱状图是应用于同一 traces 的两个选择器。 DPO 柱状图是每个训练后的模型由其训练时所用的选择器进行评分的结果。

paragraphs.en: On the shared debate, execution confidence passes the hidden check on 42.0% of questions (84/200), against 39.0% (78/200) for the vote, and passes 53.3% of public cases, against 48.6%. After DPO the same ordering holds, and the public-case gap widens. The confidence-trained model, scored by execution confidence, reaches 43.5% hidden (87/200) and 55.1% public. The vote-trained model, scored by majority voting, reaches 40.0% hidden (80/200) and 49.1% public. Training on the execution-confidence label therefore improves the cluster that the oracle keeps, on both the public count that defines the label and the stricter check used for evaluation. In this execution setting, selecting and training on how many public tests a cluster passes is the stronger rule.
paragraphs.zh: 在共享辩论设置中，执行置信度在 42.0% 的问题（84/200）上通过隐藏检查，投票则为 39.0%（78/200）；在公开案例上通过 53.3%，投票为 48.6%。 经 DPO 之后，同样的排序依然成立，且公开案例上的差距进一步扩大。 以执行置信度评分的置信度训练模型，隐藏集达到 43.5%（87/200），公开集达到 55.1%。 以多数投票评分的投票训练模型，隐藏集达到 40.0%（80/200），公开集达到 49.1%。 因此，以执行置信度标签进行训练，既提升了定义该标签所用的公开计数，也提升了评估时更严格的检查，改进了智能体保留的这一簇。 在这一执行设置中，依据智能体通过多少公开测试来选择并训练，是更强的规则。

sents.en: After DPO the same ordering holds, and the public-case gap widens.
sents.zh: 经 DPO 之后，同样的排序依然成立，且公开案例上的差距进一步扩大。

sents.en: The confidence-trained model, scored by execution confidence, reaches 43.5% hidden (87/200) and 55.1% public.
sents.zh: 以执行置信度评分的置信度训练模型，隐藏集达到 43.5%（87/200），公开集达到 55.1%。

sents.en: The vote-trained model, scored by majority voting, reaches 40.0% hidden (80/200) and 49.1% public.
sents.zh: 以多数投票评分的投票训练模型，隐藏集达到 40.0%（80/200），公开集达到 49.1%。

sents.en: Training on the execution-confidence label therefore improves the cluster that the oracle keeps, on both the public count that defines the label and the stricter check used for evaluation.
sents.zh: 因此，以执行置信度标签进行训练，既提升了定义该标签所用的公开计数，也提升了评估时更严格的检查，改进了智能体保留的这一簇。

sents.en: In this execution setting, selecting and training on how many public tests a cluster passes is the stronger rule.
sents.zh: 在这一执行设置中，依据智能体通过多少公开测试来选择并训练，是更强的规则。

paragraphs.en: The main experiments use tasks on which a final answer is a number, a choice letter, or a program, so two traces can be tested for equivalence and then counted. RaR-Medicine ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ) does not have that kind of answer. This subsection records the dataset, the checklist, the judge that turns a free-form reply of Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it into a checklist pattern, and the labeling rule that replaces a vote over those patterns. Post-training is otherwise the same pipeline as in the main experiments: a sampling-diverse committee, followed by DPO on the preferred cluster.
paragraphs.zh: 主要实验使用的任务中，最终答案是一个数字、一个选项字母或一个程序，因此可以对两条轨迹进行等价性检验并进行计数。 RaR-Medicine（Gunjal et al., 2026）不具备这类答案。 本小节记录了数据集、检查清单、将 Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it 的自由格式回复转化为检查清单模式的评判器，以及用标注规则替代对这些模式进行投票的做法。 后训练流程与主要实验中相同：一个采样多样化的委员会，随后在偏好簇上进行 DPO。

paragraphs.en: We use the medicine split of Rubrics as Rewards ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ) , released as ScaleAI/RaR-Medicine on Huggingface. Each example is a clinical question, a reference answer, and a checklist. The reference answer is not a training target and is not shown to the committee. The sweep uses 1500 training questions and 500 test questions, shuffled with the same data seed as the other datasets. Agents are asked only to answer the question completely and generate and open-ended reply.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Rubrics as Rewards（Gunjal 等，2026）的医学划分，该数据集以 ScaleAI/RaR-Medicine 的名称发布于 Huggingface。 每个样本包含一个临床问题、一个参考答案和一个检查清单。 参考答案不是训练目标，也不会展示给委员会。 扫描实验使用 1500 个训练问题和 500 个测试问题，并使用与其他数据集相同的数据种子进行打乱。 智能体被要求仅完整地回答问题并生成开放式回复。

sents.en: We use the medicine split of Rubrics as Rewards ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ) , released as ScaleAI/RaR-Medicine on Huggingface.

paragraphs.en: A checklist is an ordered list of pass/fail criteria produced by the autorubric pipeline of Gunjal et al. (2026) . Each item has a title, a description of what the response must do, and an integer weight from the release. An item contributes one hit when the judge marks it satisfied, and zero otherwise. For a question with K K criteria, a response is summarized by a bit string b ∈ { 0 , 1 } K b\in\{0,1\}^{K} . The hit count is c ⁡ ( b ) = ∑ k = 1 K b k c(b)=\sum_{k=1}^{K}b_{k} , and the hit rate (confidence) is c ⁡ ( b ) / K c(b)/K .
paragraphs.zh: 核查清单是由 Gunjal et al. (2026) 的 autorubric 流水线生成的按顺序排列的通过/失败标准列表。 每个条目包含一个标题、对响应必须完成内容的描述，以及来自发布版本的一个整数权重。 当评判者将某条目标记为满足时，该条目计为一次命中，否则计为零。 对于具有 K K 个标准的问题，一个响应由比特串 b ∈ { 0 , 1 } K b\in\{0,1\}^{K} 来概括。 命中数为 c ⁡ ( b ) = ∑ k = 1 K b k c(b)=\sum_{k=1}^{K}b_{k} ，命中率（置信度）为 c ⁡ ( b ) / K c(b)/K 。

sents.zh: 命中数为 c ⁡ ( b ) = ∑ k = 1 K b k c(b)=\sum_{k=1}^{K}b_{k} ，命中率（置信度）为 c ⁡ ( b ) / K c(b)/K 。

paragraphs.en: Equivalence is not computed from the text of the answer. A frozen judge (GPT-4o at temperature 0) reads the question, the full assistant response, and the criteria in order, and returns JSON of the form {"satisfied": [true, false, ...]} with one boolean per criterion. That boolean vector is the bit string b b . Two responses are the same cluster exactly when their bit strings match, so a cluster is one way of meeting the checklist, not a paraphrase class. The same judge is used to score the committee during debate and to score a sample at evaluation time. The reference answer is not an input to this judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 等价性不是根据答案文本计算得出的。 一个冻结的评判模型（GPT-4o，temperature 为 0）依次读取问题、完整的助手回复以及评判标准，并返回形如 {"satisfied": [true, false, ...]} 的 JSON，每个标准对应一个布尔值。 该布尔向量就是比特串 b b。 当且仅当两个回复的比特串相同时，它们才属于同一个簇，因此一个簇代表满足清单的一种方式，而不是一个改写类别。 同一个评判模型既用于在辩论过程中为委员会打分，也用于在评估时为样本打分。 参考答案不是该评判的输入。

paragraphs.en: The primary number is the weighted hit rate on the 500 test questions. For each question the judge scores the selected answer: satisfied positive criteria add their weight, satisfied negative criteria subtract, and the total is divided by the sum of the positive weights. A missing or unparseable answer counts as zero. Debate is the answer selected from the round-2 committee, before training. Each DPO entry is the policy trained on that row’s debate labels, then judged on its own test generations under the same selection rule. Table 30 reports that comparison. The rubric success rate is the fraction of test questions on which every positive criterion is satisfied and every negative criterion is avoided. A method can raise the average hit rate while still rarely clearing the whole checklist, so that rate is reported separately and is not the selection rule used for training.
paragraphs.zh: 主要指标是 500 道测试题上的加权命中率。 对于每道题，评判者对所选答案进行评分：满足的正面标准加上其权重，满足的负面标准则减去权重，总分再除以正面权重之和。 缺失或无法解析的答案计为零分。 Debate 是从第二轮委员会中选出的答案，在训练之前产生。 每个 DPO 条目是在该行的 debate 标签上训练的策略，然后根据相同的选���规则在其自身的测试生成结果上进行评判。 表 30 报告了该比较结果。 Rubric 成功率是在所有正面标准均被满足且所有负面标准均被避免的测试题所占的比例。 一种方法可以在提高平均命中率的同时仍然很少通过整个清单，因此该比率单独报告，并且不是训练所用的选择规则。

paragraphs.en: Inside a cluster every member has the same bit string, so every member has the same hit count c c . A vote assigns the cluster the score n n , the number of agents that landed on it. The rubric oracle assigns each member the weight c c and, under the same sum reduction used in the main experiments, assigns the cluster the score n ⋅ c n\cdot c . The vote therefore keeps only how often a pattern was produced. The hit count also keeps how much of the checklist that pattern covers. A pattern that meets more criteria can outrank a pattern that more agents happened to repeat. Table 31 is the definition, not a measured outcome: three agents share a checklist with 2 of 10 items satisfied, and one agent meets 8 of 10. The vote selects the first cluster. The hit-count score selects the second, because 1 ⋅ 8 > 3 ⋅ 2 1\cdot 8>3\cdot 2 . On these questions the patterns are usually all different, so a vote is a tie among singletons and the tie break is string order of the bit strings, which is unrelated to how many criteria are met. The preferred cluster under AbCD is the one with the largest hit-count (confidence) score. Completions whose judged bit string matches that cluster are the preferred side of the preference pair. The others are the rejected side. DPO then use those pairs exactly as on the verifiable tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个簇内，每个成员具有相同的比特串，因此每个成员具有相同的命中数 c c 。 投票为该簇赋予分数 n n ，即落在该簇上的智能体数量。 评分标准预言机为每个成员赋予权重 c c ，并采用与主实验相同的求和归约方式，为该簇赋予分数 n ⋅ c n\cdot c 。 因此，投票只保留了某个模式被产生的频率。 命中数还保留了该模式覆盖了多少检查清单内容。 满足更多标准的模式可以排在被更多智能体碰巧重复的模式之前。 表 31 是定义，而非实测结果：三个智能体共享一个 10 项检查清单中满足 2 项的结果，而一个智能体满足 10 项中的 8 项。 投票选择第一个簇。 命中数分数选择第二个簇，因为 1 ⋅ 8 > 3 ⋅ 2 1\cdot 8>3\cdot 2 。 在这些问题上，各模式通常互不相同，因此投票在多个单元素簇之间打成平局，而平局裁决依据是比特串的字符串顺序，这与满足标准的数量无关。 AbCD 下偏好的簇是命中数（置信度）分数最大的那个簇。 其被判定的比特串与该簇匹配的补全结果构成偏好对中的偏好一侧。 其余的构成被拒绝一侧。 DPO 随后在可验证任务上以完全相同的方式使用这些偏好对。

paragraphs.en: The quantitative results report accuracies aggregated over prompts. This section shows the same quantities on individual transcripts, so that the oracle rule in Section 3.3 can be checked against the committee that produced it. Each block is one selected prompt from an evaluation run. The gold answer is printed only to interpret the transcript. It is not an input to debate, to equivalence clustering, or to post-training. A trace is unparseable when S ⁡ ( y i ) = ∅ S(y_{i})=\varnothing , and it is placed in 𝒢 − ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{-}(x) rather than in a cluster, as in Section 3.3 . For Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it model on GSM8K dataset, every prompt on which majority voting and span confidence select different clusters has two clusters sharing the largest n k n_{k} . The blocks in Sections V.2 and V.3 are prompts of that kind.
paragraphs.zh: 定量结果报告的是在各提示上汇总后的准确率。 本节在单个对话记录上展示同样的量，以便对照产生该先验规则的委员会来检验第 3.3 节中的先验规则。 每个区块是来自一次评估运行的一个被选中的提示。 标准答案的打印仅用于解读对话记录。 它不是辩论、等价聚类或训练后处理的输入。 当 S ⁡ ( y i ) = ∅ S(y_{i})=\varnothing 时，该对话记录不可解析，它被放入 𝒢 − ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{-}(x) 而不是放入某个簇中，如第 3.3 节所述。 对于在 GSM8K 数据集上的 Qwen-2.5-1.5B-it 模型，凡是多数投票与跨度置信度选择不同簇的提示，都有两个簇共享最大的 n k n_{k} 。 第 V.2 节和第 V.3 节中的区块就是此类提示。

paragraphs.en: Violetta has 20 dollars and needs five crayons at 2 dollars each, so the change is 10 dollars. Two independent traces reach the decoding limit before a boxed answer. paragraphs.en: Preference objectives (DPO & KTO) use a prompt only when both 𝒢 + ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{+}(x) and 𝒢 − ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{-}(x) are nonempty (Section 3.4 ). A debate in which every parseable agent names the same incorrect answer has 𝒢 − ​ ( x ) = ∅ \mathcal{G}^{-}(x)=\emptyset once unparseable traces are set aside, or a 𝒢 − ​ ( x ) \mathcal{G}^{-}(x) that contains only unparseable traces. Such a prompt does not supply a competing-cluster comparison. The block documents one prompt of this kind. It is the case in which agreement is high and the selected answer is wrong, which is the regime where α ⁡ ( x ) \alpha(x) is large and correctness is not.
paragraphs.zh: 偏好目标（DPO 与 KTO）仅在 𝒢⁺(x) 和 𝒢⁻(x) 均非空时才使用该提示（见 3.4 节）。 若每个可解析的智能体都给出同一个错误答案的辩论，在剔除不可解析轨迹后，其 𝒢⁻(x) 为空集，或其 𝒢⁻(x) 仅包含不可解析的轨迹。 这样的提示无法提供竞争簇之间的比较。 该代码块记录了一个此类提示的示例。 这种情况是一致性很高但所选答案错误，即 α(x) 很大而正确性不高的情形。

paragraphs.en: In the heterogeneous committee of Section 5 , span confidence is the geometric mean of token probabilities from different tokenizers and different scales. Those scores are summed as if they were on one scale. The first prompt is one on which the winning cluster is carried by one model’s confidence mass. The second prompt is one on which a lower-confidence model has the correct answer. Per-agent accuracies for this committee are in Table 17 .
paragraphs.zh: 在第 5 节的异构委员会中，跨度置信度是来自不同分词器和不同尺度的词元概率的几何平均数。 这些分数被直接求和，就好像它们处于同一尺度上一样。 第一个提示词是指获胜簇由某一个模型的置信度质量所主导的提示词。 第二个提示词是指置信度较低的模型给出正确答案的提示词。 该委员会的各智能体准确率见表 17。

paragraphs.en: The following example shows a MBPP task trace generated using Llama-3.1-8B model committee. The committee must compute sum of positive integers down to the last positive term. There are three public tests given unit-testing the program. Before DPO, three agents agree on a program that starts at n − 2 n-2 and passes none of these tests. Execution confidence keeps the single program that starts at n n and passes all three. After DPO on the respective oracle chosen the final responses are shown below. A majority of three again passes 0 / 3 0/3 tests, while the confidence selection passes 3 / 3 3/3 . The vote follows the larger cluster. The execution-confidence oracle follows the cluster that passes the most public tests.
paragraphs.zh: 以下示例展示了使用 Llama-3.1-8B 模型委员会生成的 MBPP 任务轨迹。 该委员会必须计算正整数的和，直到最后一个正项为止。 题目给出了三个公开测试用例，用于对该程序进行单元测试。 在 DPO 之前，三个智能体一致认为某个从 n − 2 n-2 开始的程序能通过，但该程序实际上未通过任何一个测试。 执行置信度只保留从 n n 开始且通过全部三个测试的那个程序。 在对各自选定的参考答案进行 DPO 之后，最终响应如下所示。 三个智能体的多数投票再次只通过 0 / 3 0/3 个测试，而置信度选择则通过了 3 / 3 3/3 个测试。 投票遵循较大的簇。 执行置信度参考答案遵循通过最多公开测试的簇。
